The target mesh is reconstructed directly by multiplying the weights and control points, without a predefined cage, precomputed coordinates, a learned per-element deformation decoder, or a global reconstruction solve. Trained only with self-retargeting reconstruction supervision, PDB supports cross-identity transfer without paired cross-identity training expressions. Experiments demonstrate accurate retargeting, fast inference, and localized support in the learned weights. Joint evaluation of expression accuracy and local surface preservation shows reduced surface artifacts relative to the evaluated dense displacement method while retaining the intended motion. Perceptual evaluations further support expression fidelity and visual quality in both self- and cross-retargeting.

</details>


### [119] [EC-RAG: Event Chain Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Long Video Understanding](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08674)
*Yuhao Qin,Junbo Wang,Yuke Li,Yining Zhu*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出免训练框架EC-RAG，将视频组织成显式"事件链"再进行检索增强，在长视频理解任务上超越帧级检索基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有大型视频语言模型处理长视频时，帧往往被独立处理，难以捕捉跨事件的时间依赖；已有的检索增强方法多停留在帧或片段级别，无法建模事件随时间的演化及其相互关系。

Method: EC-RAG为免训练框架：先将视频划分为语义连贯的片段，用多模态信号表示每个片段，再按时间顺序链接成结构化事件链并刻画事件间关系；给定查询时在链中定位相关事件，并从关联模态收集支撑证据。

Result: 在Video-MME、MLVU和LongVideoBench上的实验表明，该以事件为中心的设计持续优于帧级检索基线。

Conclusion: 事件级抽象更贴合视频内容的自然结构，定位比帧级检索更可靠；事件级多模态融合能有效利用语音、文本与视觉的互补信息；方法即插即用，无需额外训练或依赖专有模型，凸显了建模时间结构对长视频理解的重要性。

Abstract: Current large video-language models (LVLMs) still face challenges when dealing with long videos, mainly because frames are often processed independently, making it difficult to capture temporal dependencies across events. Although retrieval-augmented approaches have been introduced to provide additional context, most of them operate at the frame or snippet level, which limits their ability to model how events evolve over time and relate to each other. In this paper, we propose Event Chain Retrieval-Augmented Generation (EC-RAG), a training-free framework that organizes video content into an explicit event chain before question answering. Instead of retrieving isolated frames or text segments, EC-RAG first partitions the video into semantically coherent segments, represents each segment using multi-modal signals, and then links them into a structured chain that preserves temporal order and captures inter-event relationships. Given a query, the system identifies relevant events within this chain and gathers supporting evidence from the associated modalities. Our approach offers several practical advantages: (i) event-level abstraction that better reflects how video content is naturally structured, enabling more reliable localization compared to frame-level retrieval; (ii) structured multi-modal fusion that aggregates speech, text, and visual cues at the event level, allowing complementary information to be more effectively utilized during reasoning; and (iii) plug-and-play compatibility with existing LVLM backbones, requiring no additional training or reliance on proprietary models. Experiments on Video-MME, MLVU, and LongVideoBench show that this event-centric design consistently outperforms frame-level retrieval baselines, highlighting the importance of modeling temporal structure for long-video understanding.

</details>


### [120] [RenderBench: Benchmarking Render-to-Real Video Transfer with Reconstructed Digital Twins](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08684)
*Dicong Qiu,Zhiyuan Xu,Yaosheng Liu,Feng Han,Bo Ye*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 该论文提出RenderBench，一个包含12个真实世界场景的基准，用于评估"从渲染到真实"（render-to-real）的视频生成能力，提供配对真实目标视频与可编辑3D数字孪生。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 评估视频模型从代理渲染生成真实外观的能力，需要同一场景演化的真实目标视频与可编辑、几何配准的3D复刻作为配对数据。而这类数据传统上需要大量人工建模、标定和动画工作，成本高昂，因此亟需一个标准化基准。

Method: 构建流程融合视觉几何、神经重建与辅助式3D编辑。每个场景被分解为静态物体和动态演员，配准到采集相机，并仅在通过多视角几何与时序验证后予以采纳。每个评估单元包含外观参考图、留出的真实目标视频、可编辑数字孪生、匹配的代理渲染及渲染器原生场景标注。评估时将迁移模型与配对真实视频对比，保留PAI-Bench-C兼容的结构投影，并利用标注按物体、可见性、关节和运动定位失败。

Result: 首个版本保留14个注册样本中的12个（85.7%），共含1,496对真实-代理帧。所有发布场景均通过文件完整性和环境编辑审计；代理诊断得到深度si-RMSE为0.2170、实例mIoU为0.3673。

Conclusion: RenderBench提供了配对的真实观测与可编辑场景状态，可用于评估外形保真度以及几何与动力学的保持程度，为render-to-real视频生成研究提供了标准化评测基础。

Abstract: Modern video models can generate realistic videos from real appearance references and proxy renders that specify scene structure, viewpoint changes, and motion. Evaluating this render-to-real capability requires a real target video depicting the same scene evolution, paired with an editable, geometrically registered 3D replica. Such data has traditionally required substantial manual modeling, calibration, and animation effort. We introduce RenderBench, a benchmark of 12 reconstructed real-world scenes spanning large-scale indoor environments and egocentric viewpoints, with both static and dynamic settings. Our construction pipeline combines visual geometry, neural reconstruction, and assisted 3D authoring. Each scene is decomposed into static objects and dynamic actors, registered to the capture cameras, and accepted only after multi-view geometric and temporal validation. Each evaluation unit contains appearance reference images, a held-out real target video, an editable digital twin, a matched proxy render, and renderer-native scene annotations. We evaluate transfer models against paired real target videos, retain PAI-Bench-C-compatible structural projections, and use scene annotations to localize failures by object, visibility, articulation, and motion. The first release retains 12 of 14 registered samples (85.7%), comprising 1,496 paired real-proxy frames. All released scenes pass file-integrity and environment-edit audits, while proxy diagnostics yield a depth si-RMSE of 0.2170 and instance mIoU of 0.3673. RenderBench provides paired real observations and editable scene state for assessing both appearance fidelity and preservation of geometry and dynamics.

</details>


### [121] [SpaTime: Streaming Vision-Language Models for Spatio-temporal Reasoning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08713)
*Hairong Yin,Huangying Zhan,Shin-Fang Chng,Yi Xu,Raymond A. Yeh*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出SpaTime，一种融合因果几何令牌的流式VLM，能边接收视频边回答3D空间问题，并引入响应时间损失来监督作答时机。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有含3D几何先验的VLM虽空间推理强但需离线运行（须等完整视频）；流式VLM可因果处理帧并自主决定何时作答，却缺乏显式3D表示。需要兼顾流式处理与3D空间推理能力，并合理决定作答时机。

Method: SpaTime在每帧将因果几何令牌融合进语言模型，仅使用已观测帧；提出响应时间损失，将逐帧响应概率映射为可微的期望响应时间，并惩罚其与真实帧的距离；构建流式基准StreamVSTI-Bench与StreamVSI-Bench。

Result: 在StreamVSTI-Bench上，SpaTime总体准确率达49.2%，相比最强流式基线将平均响应时间误差降低66%。

Conclusion: SpaTime实现了流式视频下兼顾3D空间推理与自适应作答时机的具身智能体，验证了几何融合与响应时间监督的有效性。

Abstract: Embodied agents must reason about 3D space while the video is still arriving, answering questions as soon as they have observed enough of the scene. VLMs that incorporate 3D geometric priors achieve strong spatial reasoning, but they operate offline, i.e., the full video must be available before they produce an answer. Streaming VLMs process frames causally and decide for themselves when to respond, yet they lack explicit 3D representations. We present SpaTime, a streaming VLM that fuses causal geometry tokens into the language model at every frame, using only the frames observed so far. To supervise when the model answers, we propose a response-time loss that maps per-frame response probabilities to a differentiable expected response time and penalizes the distance from the ground-truth frame. For evaluation, we construct StreamVSTI-Bench and StreamVSI-Bench, streaming adaptations of VSTI-Bench and VSI-Bench. On StreamVSTI-Bench, SpaTime reaches 49.2% overall accuracy and reduces the mean response-time error by 66% relative to the strongest streaming baseline.

</details>


### [122] [Co-Evolving Paths and Flows via Path-Flow Alignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08717)
*Zeyu Michael Li,William Xingxu Chen,Xiang Cheng*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出路径-流对齐作为统一训练目标，通过联合训练端点保持的路径网络与流网络来改进流匹配，并识别出“路径过拟合”失败模式，提出随机路径正则化器加以缓解。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统流匹配固定插值路径，仅学习速度场，路径设计未被优化。本文希望将路径也作为可学习对象，寻找更好的概率路径以提升采样质量。

Method: 联合训练端点保持的路径网络与流网络，共用同一对齐损失：流学习匹配路径速度，路径学习将速度对齐到当前流。诊断出路径过拟合及低熵瓶颈问题后，引入随机路径正则化器，在保持端点精确的前提下对路径网络隐藏部分源信息，为随机训练路径边缘分布提供熵下界。

Result: 在 ImageNet-256x256 与 SiT 骨干网络上，方法在不同模型规模下均持续提升 FID，并可扩展到 model-guidance 训练，且推理时架构与采样器保持不变。

Conclusion: 路径-流联合训练有效，但单纯对齐损失不可靠；通过随机路径正则化抑制低熵瓶颈，可显著提升生成质量，且推理零成本。

Abstract: We study path-flow alignment as a unified training objective for flow matching. Instead of fixing the interpolation path and learning only the velocity field, we jointly train an endpoint-preserving path network and a flow network using the same alignment loss: the flow learns to match the path velocity, and the path learns to align its velocity to the current flow. Although every fixed learned path defines a valid flow-matching objective, the alignment loss alone is not a reliable criterion for path learning. We identify path overfitting, a failure mode in which the alignment loss decreases while sample quality worsens. We find that this failure is associated with low-entropy bottlenecks in the induced probability path, where the learned path routes samples through overly concentrated intermediate marginals. Motivated by this diagnosis, we introduce a stochastic path regularizer that hides part of the source information from the path network while preserving exact endpoints. The resulting regularization gives an explicit entropy floor for the stochastic training-path marginals and empirically suppresses the bottleneck in the learned sampler, making joint path-flow training effective. On ImageNet-256x256 with SiT backbones, our method consistently improves FID across model scales, extends to model-guidance training, and leaves the inference-time architecture and sampler unchanged. Code is available at https://github.com/lizeyu090312/traj_opt_paper

</details>


### [123] [Post-Training Semantic Lifting for 3D Gaussian Splatting: Separating Detector, Lifting and Representation Error](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08756)
*Iván Verdugo Guerra,Ezequiel López Rubio,Jorge García González*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出一种后训练提升方法，将多视角2D检测信息融合到3D高斯泼溅模型中，实现语义分割标签从高斯到网格顶点的迁移，并分离检测器、提升和迁移三类误差来源。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 同一3D高斯在不同视角下被检测为不同类别，且存在遮挡和检测置信度不一致的问题；同时真值以标注网格给出，因为两次训练不会产生相同的高斯分布，导致难以直接进行语义监督。

Method: 逐目标类别处理，按每个高斯在各视角中的可见度加权，同时累积目标与非目标证据；随后用双阈值过滤：主阈值β选取高置信种子，较低阈值γβ加入其连通分量；评估时将标签从高斯迁移到既可见又被标注的网格顶点。

Result: 在七个Replica验证场景上调参，在十个ScanNet++测试场景中使用固定阈值。验证集mIoU在数据集掩码下为0.93、YOLO掩码下为0.65；测试集分别为0.80和0.54。相比逐视角阈值化，测试mIoU提升0.24，并可对两数据集的全部类别与场景使用单一阈值。

Conclusion: 该方法可有效融合多视角信息，实现跨表示标签迁移，并通过误差分析表明剩余误差主要来自2D检测器。

Abstract: The same Gaussian of a 3D Gaussian Splatting model is seen from many views, and these views do not always agree on the class it belongs to. The Gaussian may be occluded in some of them, and the confidence of the detector is not the same from one view to another. The ground truth, on the other hand, is given as an annotated mesh, because two training runs do not produce the same Gaussians. In this work, we propose a post-training lifting method that works with one target class at a time and combines the information coming from all the views. Target and non-target evidence are accumulated simultaneously, weighted by the visibility of each Gaussian in each view. After that, the Gaussians are filtered with two thresholds: a main threshold $β$ selects the high-confidence seeds, and a lower one $γβ$ adds the connected components around them. For the evaluation, the labels are transferred from the Gaussians to the mesh vertices that are both visible and annotated. With this design, we can separate three sources of error: the 2D detector, the lifting and the transfer between representations. The thresholds and the transfer operator are chosen on seven Replica validation scenes, and the method is evaluated on ten held-out ScanNet++ scenes with the same values for every scene and class. The mean mIoU on the validation scenes was 0.93 with masks from the dataset annotations and 0.65 with YOLO masks, and on the ScanNet++ test scenes it was 0.80 and 0.54. Compared with thresholding the evidence per view, as a previous version of the method did, the fraction improves the test mIoU by 0.24 and makes it possible to use a single threshold for all the classes and scenes of both datasets. Finally, the error analysis shows that most of the remaining error comes from the detector.

</details>


### [124] [Data Leakage in Patch-Based Hyperspectral Image Classification: Quantifying the Impact of Spatial Overlap](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08770)
*Mohammed Q. Alkhatib*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文研究基于patch的高光谱图像分类中，同类训练-测试空间重叠导致的数据泄露问题。提出重叠百分比(OP)和平均重叠率(AOR)两个度量，在Pavia University数据集上对比随机与非随机空间采样，使用SVM、MLP、2D-CNN、3D-CNN、ViT和MorpMamba。发现随机采样下深度模型精度虚高（3D-CNN达96.17% OA），非随机采样下大幅下降（3D-CNN降至55.20%），且patch尺寸增大显著提高重叠百分比。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于patch的学习通过利用局部光谱-空间信息提升了HSI分类性能，但从同一图像中随机划分训练-测试样本会导致空间patch重叠，从而产生数据泄露和过于乐观的性能估计。本文旨在量化并揭示这一问题。

Method: 提出两个度量指标：重叠百分比(OP)量化全局被重叠的测试patch像素数量；平均重叠率(AOR)衡量受影响测试patch的局部严重程度。在Pavia University数据集上，用SVM、MLP、2D-CNN、3D-CNN、ViT、MorpMamba对比随机与非随机空间采样，并进行patch尺寸分析（5x5到19x19）。

Result: 随机采样下深度patch模型精度很高，3D-CNN达96.17% OA；但非随机空间采样下大幅下降，3D-CNN降至55.20%，ViT和2D-CNN分别下降40.71和38.81个百分点。patch尺寸从5x5增至19x19时，随机采样重叠百分比从23.28%升至77.02%。

Conclusion: 随机patch评估会显著夸大分类性能，尤其是强依赖空间上下文的模型。需重视HSI分类中的数据泄露问题，并采用更严谨的评估协议。代码已开源。

Abstract: Patch-based learning improves hyperspectral image (HSI) classification by exploiting local spectral-spatial information, but random train-test sampling from the same image can cause spatial patch overlap, leading to data leakage and optimistic performance estimates. This paper investigates same-class train-test spatial overlap in patch-based HSI classification using two measures: overlap percentage (OP), which quantifies the global amount of overlapped testing patch pixels, and average overlap ratio (AOR), which measures the local severity among affected testing patches. Experiments on the Pavia University dataset compare random and non-random spatial sampling using SVM, MLP, 2D-CNN, 3D-CNN, ViT, and MorpMamba. The results show that deep patch-based models achieve high accuracy under random sampling, with 3D-CNN reaching 96.17% Overall Accuracy (OA), but drop substantially under non-random spatial sampling, where 3D-CNN decreases to 55.20% and ViT and 2D-CNN drop by 40.71 and 38.81 percentage points (PP), respectively. Patch-size analysis further shows that increasing the patch size from 5x5 to 19x19 raises the random-sampling overlap percentage from 23.28% to 77.02%. These findings demonstrate that random patch-based evaluation can substantially inflate classification performance, especially for models that strongly exploit spatial context. The code associated with this paper is available at: https://github.com/mqalkhatib/Data_Leakage_in_HSI_Classification.

</details>


### [125] [Backend-Agnostic Sparse Attention for Fast High-Resolution Visual Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08772)
*Liao Ma,Jiayi Song,Yunfeng Wu,Songhua Liu,Peilin Zhao*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出BASA，一种后端无关的稀疏注意力，通过跨DiT块的移位局部窗口注意力实现全局信息交换，兼具视觉质量与实际加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 扩散Transformer（DiTs）在图像和视频生成中表现优异，但全注意力的二次复杂度使高分辨率生成计算昂贵。现有窗口注意力方法存在权衡：分区窗口注意力计算高效但孤立窗口阻断跨窗口交互，产生可见的网格状伪影；细粒度滑窗注意力可恢复交互、提升质量，但不规则计算模式导致理论加速与实际加速差距大，且需针对各硬件后端定制内核。

Method: BASA用移位局部窗口注意力替代视觉自注意力，通过跨DiT块的结构化窗口移位方案，使某一层被窗口边界分开的token在后续层中得以通信，从而实现全局信息交换并消除窗口伪影。该设计不引入额外不规则算子或定制内核，可直接部署于现有注意力后端。

Result: 在FLUX上实现超过理论估计90%的实测加速；在Wan上实现4.52倍注意力加速，同时保持有竞争力的生成质量。

Conclusion: BASA在后端无关的稀疏注意力设计下兼顾视觉质量与实际加速，缩小了理论稀疏与实际加速之间的差距，具备良好的可部署性。

Abstract: Diffusion Transformers (DiTs) have achieved strong performance in image and video generation, but the quadratic complexity of full attention makes high-resolution generation computationally expensive. Window attention offers an efficient alternative, yet existing methods face a practical trade-off: partitioned window attention typically achieves computational efficiency consistent with its theoretical complexity. However, isolated windows block cross-window interaction, often introducing visible grid-like artifacts in the generated results. Fine-grained sliding-window attention effectively restores interactions across neighboring windows and improves visual quality. However, its irregular computation patterns create a substantial gap between theoretical and practical speedups and require specialized kernels tailored to each hardware backend. To tackle these challenges, we propose BASA, a backend-agnostic sparse attention, which brings the best of both worlds: visual quality and practical acceleration. Specifically, BASA replaces visual self-attention with shifted local-window attention. By introducing a structured window-shifting scheme across DiT blocks, we allow tokens divided by window boundaries in one layer to communicate in the following layers, thereby achieving global information exchange and eliminating window-induced visual artifacts. Notably, our design introduces no additional irregular operators or customized kernels, making it readily deployable on existing attention backends and closing the gap between theoretical sparsity and practical acceleration. Experiments demonstrate that BASA achieves measured speedups exceeding 90\% of the theoretical estimates on FLUX and delivers a 4.52$\times$ attention speedup on Wan while maintaining competitive generation quality.

</details>


### [126] [CtrlCache: Accelerating Interactive Video World Models with Control-Aware Caching](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08777)
*Shangye Song,Dong Gong,Hong Jia,Yun Sing Koh,Xinyu Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 提出免训练的CtrlCache控制感知缓存框架，通过动作变化检测调度计算复用与频域历史先验引导，在保持甚至提升生成质量的同时加速交互式视频世界模型推理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 交互式视频世界模型需高效生成视频块并忠实响应控制信号，但分块自回归+少步去噪仍需多次昂贵的去噪迭代。免训练缓存可降本，但现有策略仅依据模型内部去噪动态做复用决策，未显式考虑控制变化，且忽视了控制信号在去噪前到达这一可零成本利用的先验。

Method: 分析相邻块在不同控制状态下的相似性（动作变化处结构相似性下降、低频结构比高频细节更持久）。据此提出CtrlCache：动作感知调度与刷新策略跨块及块内检测动作变化，将块标记为初始、过渡、转折、稳态四类；在选定的内部去噪步，初始与过渡块保留完整计算，转折与稳态块复用同块内最近完整计算步的Transformer残差；并引入频率混合历史先验引导，在不额外DiT前向的情况下融合前一个干净隐变量信息。

Result: 在Matrix-Game 2.0与LingBot-World v1/v2上，CtrlCache实现1.21x至1.41x的DiT骨干加速且无需重训练，同时三个模型的WBench Overall分数均优于原始推理。

Conclusion: 显式利用控制信号进行缓存调度与频域先验引导，可在免训练条件下同时提升交互式视频世界模型的推理效率与生成质量。

Abstract: Interactive video world models need to generate each video chunk efficiently while responding faithfully to user controls. Many systems use chunk-wise autoregressive generation with few-step denoising, but each chunk still requires several costly denoising iterations. Training-free caching can reduce this cost, yet existing policies make reuse decisions primarily from model-internal denoising dynamics and do not explicitly account for control transitions. Actually, interactive generation explicitly exposes a signal they do not use: the controls for a chunk arrive before it is denoised, so a schedule derived from them costs no forward pass. To this end, we analyze adjacent chunks under different control regimes and find that structural similarity drops around action changes, while low-frequency structure remains more persistent than high-frequency detail. Motivated by these observations, we propose CtrlCache, a training-free control-aware caching framework that adapts computation to the current control sequence. Specifically, the action-aware scheduling and refresh policy detects action changes across and within chunks, and labels each chunk as initial, transition, turning, or steady state. At one selected interior denoising step, initial and transition chunks retain full computation, while turning and steady chunks reuse the transformer residual from the most recent fully computed step in the same chunk. To exploit the persistence of low-frequency structure during steady interaction, we further introduce a frequency-mixed history prior guidance that incorporates complementary information from the preceding clean latent without an additional DiT forward pass. Evaluated on Matrix-Game 2.0 and LingBot-World v1/v2, CtrlCache achieves 1.21x to 1.41x DiT-backbone speedups without model retraining while improving WBench Overall scores over original inference across all three models.

</details>


### [127] [ALIVE: Interaction-Aligned Object Insertion for First-Frame-Guided Video Editing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08779)
*Zhenghong Zhou,Zhe Lin,Jiebo Luo,Yuqian Zhou*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: ALIVE提出一种视频编辑框架，让插入的对象通过与源视频内容的连贯交互"活起来"，仅需编辑后的首帧与命名新增对象的指令，即可实现被拿起、操作等互动效果，并显著提升交互质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有视频编辑器虽能插入对象，但常难以让插入对象参与"被拿起""被操纵"等交互，插入对象与源视频动作之间缺乏协调，导致交互不真实、源内容保真度受损。

Method: 1）构建35,800个编辑对数据集，融合3D渲染、模型生成与真实视频，并引入ROSE通用编辑对，每对仅在目标对象存在与否上有差异而保留周围动作，用于教编辑模型协调对象行为与源内容；2）训练视觉语言模型（VLM）从相同输入预测交互引导信息；3）提出ALIVE-interaction基准，通过统一的VLM协议评估交互保真度、源内容保真度与视觉连贯性；4）在通用视频对象插入基准上评估。

Result: 无VLM引导时，ALIVE在两个基准上的Overall指标分别较最强评测基线提升43.9%和4.4%；引入VLM预测的引导后，在无需额外用户输入的情况下，ALIVE-interaction得分进一步提升0.95分。

Conclusion: ALIVE通过协调插入对象与源视频动作的交互，并借助VLM预测交互引导，有效解决了视频对象插入中交互不真实的问题，在交互保真度、源内容保真与视觉连贯性上均取得显著提升。

Abstract: Current video editors can insert objects but often struggle to make them participate in interactions such as being picked up or manipulated. We introduce ALIVE, a framework that makes inserted objects "alive" through coherent interactions with the source video's contents, using an edited first frame and an instruction naming only the added object. We curate 35,800 editing pairs combining 3D-rendered, model-generated, and real-world videos with general editing pairs from ROSE. Each pair differs in the target object's presence while preserving the surrounding action, teaching editors coordinated object behavior and source preservation. We further train a vision-language model (VLM) to predict interaction guidance from the same inputs. We introduce the ALIVE-interaction benchmark to assess interaction fidelity, source preservation, and visual coherence using a unified VLM-based protocol, and evaluate on the general video object insertion benchmark. Without VLM guidance, ALIVE improves Overall over the strongest evaluated baseline by 43.9% and 4.4% on the two benchmarks, respectively. VLM-predicted guidance further improves the ALIVE-interaction score by 0.95 points without additional user inputs.

</details>


### [128] [4D-HOF: Hand-Object Flow Matching for Feed-Forward 4D Interaction Reconstruction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08782)
*Shiqi Li,Sean Cho,Yijie Li,Fengzhi Guo,Bowen Wen,Cheng Zhang*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 4D-HOF 是一种前馈框架，利用视觉基础模型的粗略估计，通过条件流匹配将手-物状态传输至交互流形，实现从生成过程内部进行测试时引导的4D手-物交互重建。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有4D手-物重建方法依赖昂贵的逐序列优化，而生成式方法从随机噪声合成交互，导致预测不稳定，因此需要一种既高效又稳定准确的重建方案。

Method: 学习条件流匹配模型，将视觉基础模型导出的手-物状态传输至交互流形，前馈式修正平移、旋转和对齐误差；并在传输过程中直接引入物理交互约束与观测到的2D证据进行测试时引导，而非事后单独优化。

Result: 在域外基准测试上，4D-HOF 达到最先进性能，生成更稳定、更准确的4D手-物重建结果。

Conclusion: 通过在多样数据集上训练，4D-HOF 对具有挑战性的野外场景具有强泛化能力，验证了将引导融入生成过程的有效性。

Abstract: Existing methods for 4D hand-object reconstruction often rely on costly per-sequence optimization, while generative approaches typically synthesize interactions from random noise, which can lead to unstable interaction prediction. We introduce 4D-HOF, a feed-forward framework that reconstructs 4D hand-object interactions from coarse but informative estimates produced by vision foundation models. Concretely, we learn a conditional flow matching model that transports foundation-model-derived hand-object states toward an interaction manifold, allowing the model to correct errors in translation, rotation, and alignment in a feed-forward manner. A key advantage of our generative formulation is that it naturally enables test-time guidance within the transport process. Rather than applying a separate post-hoc optimization after reconstruction, we directly steer the evolving generative states using physical interaction constraints and observed 2D evidence, allowing the reconstruction to be refined as part of the generative process itself. By training the generative model on diverse datasets, 4D-HOF generalizes robustly to challenging in-the-wild scenarios. Experiments on out-of-domain benchmarks show that 4D-HOF achieves state-of-the-art performance, producing more stable and accurate 4D hand-object reconstructions.

</details>


### [129] [Building Rome from a Single Image](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08790)
*Jiraphon Yenphraphai,Fang Li,Tianshuo Xu,Depu Meng,Quentin Herau,Yihan Hu,Raymond A. Yeh,Wei Zhan*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出一种将物体为中心的3D生成器改造为适用于室内外场景的单图场景生成方法，通过自适应分块、显式2D-3D对应建模以及合成约4000个室外场景数据，在Tanks and Temples、ScanNet++及真实图片上取得几何精度与感知质量的最佳表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 单图场景生成需要从单张图像推断出相机未观测区域的完整3D场景网格。现有预训练3D物体生成器虽具备强形状先验，但主要面向固定规范体积内的孤立物体，且以室内场景为主，因为多样化的室外3D数据十分有限。因此需要一种能同时适用于室内外场景、且保留原有物体先验的改造方案。

Method: 方法对以物体为中心的生成器（如Trellis 2）进行重设计，包含三个关键点：(a) 将场景划分为随相机距离缩放的自适应分块，近处块尺寸更小以保留细节，远处结构（如建筑）用大块覆盖；(b) 通过提升图像特征并让模型感知自由空间、已观测表面和未观测区域，使生成器捕获显式的2D-3D对应关系；(c) 合成约4000个室外场景以扩充训练数据，弥补现有场景数据集以室内为主的不足。

Result: 在Tanks and Temples、ScanNet++以及真实（in-the-wild）图像上的实验表明，该方法在室内外场景的几何精度和感知质量方面均优于所有基线方法。

Conclusion: 通过对物体中心生成器进行自适应分块、显式2D-3D对应建模及室外数据合成等改造，可在保留预训练形状先验的同时，实现兼顾室内外的高质量单图3D场景生成。

Abstract: Single-image scene generation aims to produce a complete 3D scene mesh from a single image, including surfaces the camera did not observe. While pretrained 3D object generators encode a strong shape prior, they are mainly designed for isolated objects in a fixed canonical volume and focus mostly on indoor scenes, since diverse 3D data for outdoor scenes are quite limited. In this work, we present a method that redesigns such an object-centric generator, e.g., Trellis 2, to work on both indoor and outdoor scenes while retaining its prior. We accomplish this by (a) partitioning the scene into adaptive chunks that scale relative to the distance to the camera; nearby chunks have a smaller size to keep the finer detail, while distant structures, e.g., buildings, are covered by large chunks; (b) making the generator capture explicit 2D-3D correspondence by lifting image features and making the model aware of the free space, observed surface, and unobserved region; (c) synthesizing around 4,000 outdoor scenes to broaden the training data, as existing scene datasets are largely indoor. Experiments on Tanks and Temples, ScanNet++, and in-the-wild images show that our method outperforms all baselines in geometric accuracy and perceptual quality across both indoor and outdoor scenes.

</details>


### [130] [World Models' Last Exam in Physics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.08791)
*Mingju Gao,Qingle Liu,Yuzhao Peng,Xinjie Lin,Ziming Qin,Zheng Jiang,Wenyi Li,Calvin Xiao,Youjie Zheng,Kaisen Yang,Qinhuai Na*

Main category: cs.CV

TL;DR: 本文提出"世界模型物理学的最后考试"（World Models' Last Exam in Physics），一个基于测量的视频世界模型物理一致性基准，包含40个受控任务，覆盖力学、光学、流体、热学与相变、电磁学和表面张力，通过任务可观测性筛选与任务特定定量物理测量进行评估。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视频世界模型能生成视觉上逼真但物理上不一致的序列，这对具身AI系统的预测与规划可靠性构成隐患。现有评估多依赖模型判断或参考视频，直接的物理测试又主要局限于力学，缺乏覆盖多物理领域且基于测量的评估手段。

Method: 构建包含40个受控任务的基准，覆盖六个物理领域；每个任务配对初始图像、生成提示与预定义物理标准，无需参考视频即可进行可解释的物理关系测试；评估器结合任务可观测性筛选与任务特定的定量物理测量。

Result: 在八个视频生成模型、共1280个视频上的实验显示持续存在的物理不一致和任务间显著差异，最佳模型总分仅57.76/100。在已知物理关系的合成视频上验证了测量模块的有效性；评估器在与人类判断的一致性上优于直接的视觉语言模型基线，无论任务内排序还是成对比较。

Conclusion: 该基准结合多物理领域覆盖、基于可测量证据的评分以及明确的测量局限，为诊断物理不一致、追踪视频世界模型物理一致性进展提供了可解释的基础。

Abstract: Video world models can produce visually convincing yet physically inconsistent sequences, raising concerns about their reliability for prediction and planning in embodied AI systems. Existing evaluations often rely on model-based judgments or reference videos, while direct physical tests largely focus on mechanics. We introduce World Models' Last Exam in Physics, a measurement-based benchmark for evaluating physical consistency in video world models. The benchmark comprises 40 controlled tasks spanning mechanics, optics, fluids, thermal and phase-change phenomena, electromagnetism, and surface tension. Each task pairs an initial image and a generation prompt with predefined physical criteria, enabling interpretable tests of observable physical relationships without requiring reference videos. Its evaluator combines task-observability screening with task-specific quantitative physical measurements. Experiments on eight video generation models across 1,280 videos reveal persistent physical inconsistencies and substantial variation across tasks, with the best model achieving an overall score of 57.76 out of 100. Evaluation on synthetic videos with known physical relationships provides evidence for the validity of the measurement module under controlled conditions. The evaluator also achieves higher agreement with human judgments than a direct vision-language model baseline in both within-task rankings and pairwise comparisons. By combining coverage across physical domains with scores grounded in measurable evidence and explicit measurement limitations, the benchmark provides an interpretable basis for diagnosing physical inconsistencies and tracking progress toward physically consistent video world models.

</details>


<div id='cs.AI'></div>

# cs.AI [[Back]](#toc)

### [131] [GAMEGO: Training Game-Dev Agents with Synthetic Trajectories Anchored in Real-World Assets](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06910)
*Haoyue Yang,Jingyao Li,Zhengfan Wu,Jing Liu,Xuanle Zhao,Kang Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出GameGo框架，将简短的"游戏种子"系统化扩展为符合行业实践的产品需求文档，并配合任务特定的动态压缩策略，构建了包含55,060条开发轨迹的GameGoData数据集与124个查询的GameGoBench基准，训练出的GameGoCoder在游戏开发基准上超越同类基线并接近前沿模型。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有浏览器端游戏生成研究多依赖复杂的多轮工作流，或仅关注静态游戏评测基准。直接从稀疏的用户查询端到端生成复杂游戏时，编码智能体被迫做出大量未充分说明的假设，导致机制不完整、玩法流程割裂、视觉表现受限。因此需要一种能系统化补全需求、提升生成质量的框架。

Method: GameGo是一个可扩展框架：先将简短的游戏种子转化为基于行业游戏开发实践的完整产品需求文档（PRD）；在不限制设计探索空间的前提下保留核心玩法约束，采用任务特定的动态压缩来最大化信息密度并保持指令遵循能力。基于该流水线构建了GameGoData数据集（覆盖2D、2.5D、3D游戏，共55,060条开发轨迹），并提出包含124个多样化游戏查询的GameGoBench基准。

Result: 在GameGoData上训练的GameGoCoder模型在各项游戏开发基准上超越了同等规模的基线模型，并与前沿模型表现相当。

Conclusion: 通过将简短游戏需求系统化扩展为完整的产品需求文档并配合动态压缩策略，能够有效提升编码智能体端到端生成复杂游戏的能力。所有代码、数据集与模型将公开。

Abstract: Recent advances in Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated remarkable capabilities in web front-end execution, with browser-based game generation emerging as a particularly prominent frontier. While previous efforts frequently rely on complex multi-turn workflows or focus on static game evaluation benchmarks, this work targets direct end-to-end real-world game synthesis driven by coding agents. However, generating complex games directly from sparse user queries often forces coding agents to make underspecified assumptions, yielding incomplete mechanics, disconnected gameplay flows, and limited visual aesthetics. To resolve this issue, this paper presents GameGo, a scalable framework that systematically transforms brief game seeds into comprehensive Product Requirements Documents grounded in industry game-development practices. To retain core gameplay constraints without restricting design exploration, GameGo uses task-specific dynamic compression to maximize information density while preserving instruction following. Based on this pipeline, GameGoData is constructed with 55,060 development trajectories across 2D, 2.5D, and 3D games, alongside GameGoBench, a benchmark comprising 124 diverse game queries. Training GameGoCoder on GameGoData yields a model that outperforms matched baselines and is comparable to frontier models across gamedev benchmarks. All code, datasets, and models will be made publicly available.

</details>


### [132] [Text2Dashboard: A Governed Agent Architecture for Natural-Language Dashboard Generation over Enterprise DataBrain](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06914)
*Yiou Wu,Zezhi Tang,Ningwei Bai,Liuhaichen Yang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: Text2Dashboard 是一个将自然语言分析请求转化为可审查仪表盘的原型系统，结合模型决策与确定性控制。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 将自然语言分析请求转化为仪表盘时，需要兼顾模型灵活性、执行可控性与可审查性。

Method: 采用 Codex 插件与 Agent Runtime，结合 schema 约束的模型决策、类型化工具、持久状态和确定性 Hooks，实现实体解析、元数据发现、只读 SQL、仪表盘组合及静态/动态检查。

Result: 在冻结真实任务上，元数据选择 4/4 通过，四个 SQL 任务满足语义标准、2/4 满足精确输出列；最终版本通过 4/4 单面板任务、一个双面板任务和一个已有仪表盘改进；十个故障场景均达标；模型推理占运行时间 97% 以上。

Conclusion: 结果仅限特定 DataBrain 场景，不能证明生产可用性、通用 text-to-SQL 准确性或相较人工构建仪表盘的效率优势。

Abstract: Text2Dashboard is a DataBrain-specific prototype that turns natural-language analytic requests into inspectable dashboards. An installable Codex plugin and standalone Agent Runtime combine schema-constrained model decisions with typed tools, persistent state, and deterministic Hooks for approval, audit, checkpointing, recovery, and failure handling. The pipeline resolves entities, discovers metadata, enforces read-only SQL, composes dashboards, and applies static checks, dynamic preflight, and browser inspection. The model proposes actions while deterministic software controls execution and records state transitions.
  We evaluate the workflow on frozen real-DataBrain tasks and controlled Hook faults. Strict success was 6/8 on metadata and SQL tasks: metadata selection passed 4/4, all four SQL tasks met semantic criteria, and 2/4 met the exact output-column contract. The final release passed 4/4 single-panel dashboard tasks, one two-panel task, and one existing-dashboard refinement; a parameterised task exceeded its step limit. All ten fault scenarios met their specified outcomes without unapproved external side effects. Model inference accounted for over 97\% of observed runtime in every reported group. These small, DataBrain-specific results do not establish production readiness, general text-to-SQL accuracy, or an efficiency advantage over manual dashboard construction.

</details>


### [133] [FluidPD: In-Place Elasticity for SLO-Aware Prefill-Decode Disaggregated LLM Serving](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06917)
*Kartik Ramesh,Kaidi Fu,Zihan Zheng,Jiahuan Yu,Fabio Oliveira,Carlos Costa,Minjia Zhang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: FluidPD 是一种具备 SLO 感知的原位弹性 P/D 分离服务系统，通过 FluidToken 与 FluidRole 两个机制应对瞬态与持续性的预填充/解码负载失衡，无需额外 GPU 即可显著提升 SLO 达成率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 P/D 分离 LLM 服务系统通常采用固定的预填充/解码工作节点比例与请求路由，但真实负载同时存在短时突发和持续性的 P/D 需求比例变化。固定配置很快失配，导致即使别处有空闲容量也会违反延迟 SLO。现有自动扩缩容反应慢、需要额外 GPU，且无法直接应对短时间尺度的阶段失衡。

Method: FluidPD 引入两个互补机制：FluidToken 在解码端有空闲时，将有限部分的预填充计算卸载到解码工作节点，以应对瞬态失衡；FluidRole 在原位重新分配运行中的工作节点于预填充和解码角色之间，避免模型重载与引擎重启，以应对持续性失衡。两者均由轻量级压力指标引导，在资源压力演变为 SLO 违规之前将其暴露出来。

Result: 在生产级 Azure 追踪负载上，FluidPD 相比静态 SGLang 将整体 SLO 达成率最多提升 94.6 个百分点，且无需额外配置工作节点。

Conclusion: SLO 感知的原位 P/D 弹性能够在不多配置工作节点的前提下改善服务质量，证明该方案可有效应对真实负载中的阶段失衡问题。

Abstract: Prefill-decode disaggregation is becoming a common architecture for LLM serving because it separates two phases with distinct execution patterns and SLO objectives. Existing systems typically combine a fixed prefill/decode worker ratio with request routing across workers. However, real-world workloads exhibit both short bursts and sustained shifts in the prefill-to-decode demand ratio. As a result, a configuration that is well provisioned at one time may quickly become mismatched, causing latency SLO violations even when idle capacity exists elsewhere. Existing autoscaling mechanisms can add capacity, but they react slowly, require spare GPUs, and do not directly address short-timescale phase imbalance.
  We present FluidPD, a P/D-disaggregated serving system that provides SLO-aware in-place elasticity. FluidPD introduces two complementary mechanisms. FluidToken handles transient imbalance by offloading a bounded portion of prefill computation to decode workers when decode-side slack is available. FluidRole handles sustained imbalance by reassigning running workers between prefill and decode roles in place, avoiding model reload and engine restart. Both mechanisms are guided by lightweight pressure indices that expose prefill and decode-side resource pressure before they appear as SLO violations. Across production Azure trace workloads, FluidPD improves overall SLO attainment over static SGLang by up to 94.6 percentage points, demonstrating that SLO-aware in-place P/D elasticity improves service quality without provisioning additional workers.

</details>


### [134] [Anchor Divergence for Semantic Geometry in Contrastive Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06919)
*Akash Kannan,Kiho Park,Victor Veitch*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出"锚点散度"方法，通过对锚点分布建模来为固定的对比表征指定上下文相关的语义几何结构，用于高效的上下文相关检索。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 语义相似性本质上是上下文相关的：两张图像可能因同一物体、相似视觉风格或相关临床发现而相似。然而余弦相似度只提供单一固定的几何结构，无法刻画这种上下文依赖性，因此需要一种能在固定表征上指定上下文相关语义几何的方法。

Method: 利用对比学习、指数族与信息几何之间的相互作用，建立"锚点"上的概率分布与表征空间上Bregman几何之间的对应关系。基于该对应关系定义"锚点散度"（Anchor Divergences），用于在固定表征上指定上下文特定的语义几何；在此框架下，对锚点分布建模即等价于对几何本身建模。

Result: 检索实验表明，锚点散度能够有效且高效地指定上下文相关的语义相似性。

Conclusion: 对比表征天然包含一族可针对特定语义结构进行特化的几何；通过锚点分布与Bregman几何的对应，锚点散度为上下文相关语义相似性提供了一种有效且高效的建模方式。

Abstract: This paper concerns how semantic context determines geometry in learned vector representations. Similarity is typically measured using cosine similarity, which provides a single fixed geometry. Semantic similarity, however, is inherently context dependent: two images may be similar because they depict the same object, share a visual style, or are relevant to the same clinical finding. We show that contrastive representations naturally encompass a family of geometries that can be specialized to particular semantic structure. The key idea is to use an interplay between contrastive learning, exponential families, and information geometry to establish a correspondence between probability distributions over "anchors" and Bregman geometries on the representation space. We use this correspondence to define "Anchor Divergences", a method for specifying context-specific semantic geometries on fixed representations. Under this correspondence, modeling the anchor distribution models the geometry itself. Experiments on retrieval show that anchor divergences provide an effective and efficient way to specify context-specific semantic similarity.

</details>


### [135] [RadOnc-Agent: An LLM-Orchestrated Framework for AI Workflows Across the Radiotherapy Care Pathway](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06923)
*Caiwen Jiang,Shuoyang Wei,Songlin Zhao,Junyu Li,Jingyuan Chen,Wei Liu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出 RadOnc-Agent，一个 LLM 编排的智能体框架，将放疗流程形式化为四个临床阶段、提供 26 个可调用函数，并通过对话接口协调异构放疗能力。评估显示单函数意图选择准确率 98.79%、跨阶段脚本化流程完成率 96.50%、真实患者流程完成率 96.67%，验证了技术可行性，但未证明临床正确性与实际获益。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当前人工智能虽在单项放疗任务上取得进展，但能力分散于不同临床阶段、软件环境与数据模态，彼此割裂。这与放疗从治疗决策到随访的纵向连续流程不匹配，缺乏统一协调机制。

Method: 提出 RadOnc-Agent 智能体框架：将放疗形式化为四个临床阶段，提供 26 个可调用函数及对话式交互界面；由大语言模型控制器将临床意图映射为受模式约束的函数调用，维护患者与工作流上下文，并将请求路由至专业服务。评估采用 2600 条单函数请求（7800 次重复执行）、200 个预设合成跨阶段场景（600 次执行）及来自 60 份去标识患者记录的 120 个工作流实例（360 次清洁执行），并开展消融对比实验。

Result: 单函数执行中意图函数选择正确率 98.79%；脚本化跨阶段流程完成率 96.50%；真实患者流程执行完成率 96.67%。消融实验中，移除纵向状态使跨阶段完成率从 96.50% 降至 84.00%；禁用模式与身份校验使后端错误派发率从 0% 升至 95.28%（重放/测试评估）。

Conclusion: 研究确立了 LLM 编排架构在协调异构放疗能力与信息、支撑纵向工作流方面的技术可行性；但未证明临床正确性、临床实用性或前瞻性获益。

Abstract: Artificial intelligence has advanced individual radiotherapy tasks, yet these capabilities remain separated across clinical stages, software environments and data modalities. This fragmentation contrasts with the longitudinal radiotherapy workflow from treatment decision-making through follow-up. Here we present RadOnc-Agent, an agentic artificial-intelligence framework that formalizes radiotherapy into four clinical phases and provides 26 callable functions through a conversational interface. A large-language-model controller maps clinical intent to schema-constrained calls, preserves patient and workflow context, and routes requests to specialist services. We evaluated system execution using 2,600 single-function requests (7,800 repeat executions), 200 prespecified synthetic cross-stage scenarios spanning four phases (600 executions), and 120 workflow instances from 60 de-identified patient records (360 clean executions) representing decision-to-planning and planning-to-adaptation. RadOnc-Agent selected the intended function in 98.79% of single-function executions, completed 96.50% of scripted cross-stage workflows, and completed 96.67% of real-patient workflow executions. In comparative ablations, removing longitudinal state reduced cross-stage completion from 96.50% to 84.00%, while disabling schema and identity validation increased mismatched backend dispatch from 0% to 95.28% in a replay/test evaluation. These findings establish the technical feasibility of an LLM-orchestrated architecture for coordinating heterogeneous radiotherapy capabilities and information across longitudinal workflows; they do not establish clinical correctness, clinical utility or prospective benefit.

</details>


### [136] [Metonymic Circuits for Abstract Concept Grounding in Vision Transformers](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06928)
*Jing Ding,Ziqiao Ma,Jiayuan Mao,Joyce Chai,Freda Shi*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该研究提出并验证了视觉Transformer中抽象概念（如"愤怒"）的"转喻式" grounding 机制：抽象预测由可解释的具体锚点概念（如"火"）驱动，通过Transcoder在CLIP和DINO中恢复中间语义特征并追踪其电路贡献。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 当训练数据缺乏直接的指称证据时，Vision Transformers如何将抽象概念（如angry）与视觉信号联系起来，这一问题尚不清楚。

Method: 假设存在转喻式grounding机制，即抽象预测由具体、可解释的锚点概念（如fire）驱动，从而桥接视觉信号与抽象语义；在CLIP和DINO视觉编码器上应用Transcoders恢复可关联语义标签的中间特征，并追踪其在抽象概念识别电路中的贡献；在精心筛选的图标数据集上进行实验，并进行因果干预验证。

Result: 实验发现结构化的转喻电路：感知基元在早期层占主导，类物体锚点先于抽象目标出现；含渲染文本的图像则招募一条不同的感知到文本路径；因果干预进一步证实转喻中间特征在功能上参与抽象概念 grounding。

Conclusion: Vision Transformers通过转喻式机制实现抽象概念grounding，具体锚点概念在其中起关键中介作用，揭示了抽象语义与视觉信号之间的结构化、可解释的映射路径。

Abstract: We study how Vision Transformers ground abstract concepts (e.g., angry) when training data provide limited direct referential evidence. We hypothesize a metonymic grounding mechanism in which abstract predictions are driven by concrete, interpretable anchor concepts (e.g., fire) that bridge visual signals to abstract semantics. By applying Transcoders on CLIP and DINO vision encoders, we recover intermediate features that can be associated with semantic labels for more concrete concepts, and trace their contributions in circuits underlying abstract concept recognition. Experiments on a carefully curated icon dataset reveal structured metonymic circuits, in which perceptual primitives dominate early layers and object-like anchors precede abstract targets. Images containing rendered text instead recruit a distinct perceptual-to-textual route. Causal interventions further validate that metonymic intermediates are functionally involved in grounding abstract concepts.

</details>


### [137] [Principles that Guide, Actions that Inform: Agent Evolution via Knowledge Abstraction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06964)
*Bowen Ye,Yongchao Xu,Junkai Ma,Xiang Yin,Wenzhao Li*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出SAGA框架，将LLM智能体的交互经验逐层抽象为情景描述、可复用流程和带适用条件的原则，并回注到决策中，形成执行-抽象反馈闭环，在ScienceWorld和ALFWorld上提升任务表现。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: LLM智能体在交互环境中能力强，但难以从经验中持续进化。微调依赖参数访问且计算成本高，不适合大规模和闭源模型；外部记忆虽无需改参数，但现有方法偏重经验表示与组织，知识仍与具体任务和情境强耦合，泛化性差。核心挑战是把具体交互转化为抽象、可复用、能指导未来决策的知识。

Method: SAGA（Self-evolving Agents through Experience-Grounded Abstraction）框架：将交互轨迹逐步转化为情景描述、可复用流程、以及带显式适用条件的原则，并保留与执行证据的链接。检索到的原则被实例化为任务特定指导，通过纠正性反馈与重采样来修正候选动作，从而形成"执行—抽象"反馈闭环：积累的知识指导未来交互，新经验又持续更新分层记忆。

Result: 在ScienceWorld和ALFWorld上任务表现提升；消融实验表明情境化实例化与动作调控对利用原则级知识十分关键。

Conclusion: 该工作表明，通过分层抽象与原则级知识的实例化，智能体可在不修改模型参数的前提下实现自我进化，为外部记忆驱动的持续学习提供了可行路径。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM) agents have demonstrated strong capabilities in interactive environments, yet their ability to continually evolve from experience remains limited. Although fine-tuning enables adaptation, its dependence on parameter access and high computational costs restrict its flexibility, especially for large-scale and closed-source LLMs. External memory offers an alternative by allowing agents to accumulate experience without modifying model parameters. However, existing methods mainly focus on experience representation and organization, while the acquired knowledge remains tightly coupled with specific tasks and contexts, limiting generalization. A key challenge is how to transform concrete interactions into abstract and reusable knowledge that guides future decisions beyond individual experiences.
  To address this challenge, we propose SAGA (\underline{\textbf{S}}elf-evolving \underline{\textbf{A}}gents through Experience-\underline{\textbf{G}}rounded \underline{\textbf{A}}bstraction), a framework for experience-grounded knowledge abstraction and utilization in LLM agents. SAGA progressively transforms interaction trajectories into episodic descriptions, reusable procedures, and principles with explicit applicability conditions, while maintaining links to execution evidence. Retrieved principles are instantiated into task-specific guidance and used to refine candidate actions through corrective feedback and resampling. This creates an execution--abstraction feedback loop, where accumulated knowledge guides future interactions and new experiences continuously update hierarchical memory. Experiments on ScienceWorld and ALFWorld demonstrate improved task performance, with ablation studies highlighting the importance of contextual instantiation and action regulation for leveraging principle-level knowledge.

</details>


### [138] [AegisFlow: A Multi-Agent Agentic AI Framework for Autonomous Remediation and Self-Healing in Fragile Data Ecosystems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06971)
*Muhammad Bilal Awan,Zubair Hussain,Abdul Shahid*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: AegisFlow是一个基于LLM智能体的自愈框架，通过Watchdog与Repair双智能体及Parallel Shadow Patching机制，将数据管道故障修复的MTTR从170分钟降至3.2分钟，补丁成功率达92%。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统数据管道脆弱，易因上游schema漂移、API契约变更或网站DOM修改而失败。现有可观测性工具仅向人工工程师告警，导致MTTR高、运维疲劳，检测与解决之间存在断层。

Method: 提出AegisFlow框架：由Watchdog智能体采集运行时遥测数据，Repair智能体基于大语言模型自动生成、测试并部署代码补丁；采用基于MAPE-K循环的非侵入式Parallel Shadow Patching执行模型，在数字孪生环境中生成并验证补丁；以插件方式集成到现有管道编排系统。

Result: 在五类常见故障场景下评估：MTTR改善98.1%（从平均每补丁170分钟降至3.2分钟），补丁成功率92%。其中JSON schema变更成功率96%、标点漂移98%、Shadow DOM场景最低为85%。可释放约98%的数据工程值班时间用于创新。

Conclusion: AegisFlow通过智能体闭环实现数据管道故障的自动检测与修复，具有部署无关性，可作为插件低成本集成到现有编排系统，显著降低运维负担。

Abstract: Traditional data pipelines are notoriously brittle, often failing due to upstream schema drift, API contract changes, or website DOM modifications. Present observability tools only raise alerts but for human engineers, resulting in a high Mean Time to Repair (MTTR) and operational fatigue. In this paper we propose AegisFlow (Agentic Engine for Intelligent Self-healing and Graph-driven Operations for Workload remediation), a novel agentic framework that closes the loop between detection and resolution. AegisFlow uses a Watchdog agent to collect runtime telemetry and has a Repair agent to automatically create, test and deploy code patches based on Large Language Models (LLMs). The framework presents the non-intrusive execution model called Parallel Shadow Patching, a non-intrusive execution model based on the Monitor, Analyze, Plan, Execute, Knowledge (MAPE-K) loop to generate and verify patches in digital twin environments. Through experimental testing, we have evaluated AegisFlow across five common failure scenarios, and see 98.1 percent improvement in MTTR (from an average of 170 minutes per patch to 3.2 minutes) and a patch success rate of 92 percent . In particular, the system is successful in dealing with changes in the JSON schema (96 percent ) and punctuation drift (98 percent ), and is least successful in Shadow DOM cases (85 percent ). AegisFlow frees up about 98 percent of data engineering on-call time from firefighting and reallocates it towards innovation. The framework is deployment agnostic consisting of a system that can be deployed in a plugin fashion into an existing pipeline orchestration system with minimal uplift to the existing system.

</details>


### [139] [EPOCH: Reliable Discovery through Evidence-Governed Search](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06986)
*Binjie Guo,Aisheng Mo,Ruitong Li,Xinle Deng*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: EPOCH 提出"证据治理"架构,通过显式任务契约、类型化记忆、主动证伪、准入检查与独立复现来规范评审反馈的使用,在 AlgoTune、Math14 等任务上取得领先表现,产出可执行构造、优化算法、反例与有证明支撑的结果。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 AI 研究智能体通常只优化评价器反馈,却缺乏对反馈如何被解释、质疑与复用的治理,导致脆弱候选被误判为发现,基准提升、有限证书与定理级结论被混淆。

Method: EPOCH 是一个证据治理架构,实现证据治理式发现循环,结合五要素:显式任务契约、类型化记忆、主动证伪、准入检查、独立复现;每个候选方案都按其所述主张的强度与范围进行评估。

Result: 在 AlgoTune 上取得最优总体性能,平均归一化得分 0.65(最强基线 0.53);Math14 内部套件最高均分 0.57;在官方测试复现下表现良好;AgentHPO 描述性汇总领先;在十个发现问题上取得可执行构造、算法优化、反例与有证明支撑的结果等具体进展。

Conclusion: 证据治理是迈向"既产出更强解、也产出更可信科学发现"的 AI 研究智能体的必要一步。

Abstract: AI research agents are increasingly used to search over programs, mathematical constructions, and proofs. However, existing systems typically optimize evaluator feedback without adequately governing how that feedback is interpreted, challenged, and reused. As a result, promising but fragile candidates can be promoted as discoveries, while benchmark improvements, finite certificates, and theorem-level claims are too easily conflated. We introduce EPOCH, an evidence-governed architecture designed to close this gap. EPOCH implements an evidence-governed discovery loop by combining explicit task contracts, typed memory, active falsification, admission checks, and independent replay, so that each candidate is evaluated against the strength and scope of the claim it supports. EPOCH achieves state-of-the-art aggregate performance on AlgoTune, substantially exceeding the strongest baseline in mean normalized score (0.65 vs. 0.53), and attains the highest mean score on the internal Math14 suite (0.57). It further shows favorable held-out behavior under official-test replay and leads the descriptive aggregate on AgentHPO. Across ten discovery problems, EPOCH delivers substantial task-specific advances, including improved executable constructions, optimized algorithms, counterexamples, and proof-supported results. These advances demonstrate its ability to convert search into concrete progress across mathematical and computational domains. Together, the results suggest that evidence governance is a necessary step toward AI research agents that produce not only stronger solutions, but also more trustworthy scientific discoveries.

</details>


### [140] [When better traffic forecasts fail to improve signal control: a layered diagnostic study of forecast-to-decision value](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06992)
*Jianing Long,Xiaobin Li,Wuming Lei,Weiguang Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该研究通过分层诊断框架，结合中国宣城29天重建需求数据，检验交通预测精度提升是否真正转化为信号控制收益，发现预测改进并不必然带来更优闭环控制决策。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 交通预测精度常被默认能改善信号控制决策，但两者之间存在转化断层；作者希望系统诊断"预测更好却控制未更优"的原因。

Method: 使用29天重建需求数据（7天测试），评估点预测、保形区间、依赖感知场景与匹配的闭环控制器；进行入口级与流向级预测、接口审计（发现决策时泄漏、9个受控路口仅2个存在多个有效动作），修正时间接口，并将因果预测与五秒事件预言机在穷举联合动作搜索下比较。

Result: 入口级与流向级预测相对历史均值将MAE分别降低4.03%与3.92%；名义90%保形区间边际覆盖率达90.72%，但在事后高需求子集仅75.66%。合成阳性对照显示未来信息可降低61.5%的内部推演成本。冻结测试日上，因果预测与事件预言机相对无未来推演分别使排队车秒增加6.09%与3.39%，预言机使溢流暴露降低3.78%，配对日自助法区间跨零。

Conclusion: 预测价值取决于时间可观测性、动作可识别性、动力学一致性与目标对齐；所提协议可实用地诊断预测改进为何未能转化为运行收益。

Abstract: Improved traffic forecasts do not necessarily yield better signal-control decisions. We investigate this gap through a layered diagnostic study using 29 days of reconstructed demand from Xuancheng, China, with seven dates reserved for testing. The framework evaluates point forecasts, conformal intervals, dependence-aware scenarios, and matched closed-loop controllers. Entry-level and movement-level forecasts reduce mean absolute error by 4.03% and 3.92%, respectively, relative to historical means. A nominal 90% conformal interval achieves 90.72% marginal coverage but only 75.66% on an ex-post high-demand subset. Interface audits identify decision-time leakage and reveal that only two of nine controlled intersections offer multiple effective actions. We correct the temporal interface and compare causal forecasts with a five-second event oracle using exhaustive joint-action search. A synthetic positive control demonstrates that future information can reduce the internal rollout cost by 61.5%. On the frozen test dates, however, causal forecasts and the event oracle increase queue vehicle?seconds by 6.09% and 3.39% relative to the matched no-future rollout, while the oracle reduces spillback exposure by 3.78%; paired-day bootstrap intervals cross zero. These findings indicate that forecast value depends on temporal observability, action identifiability, dynamics consistency, and objective alignment. The proposed protocol provides a practical way to diagnose where predictive improvements fail to translate into operational benefits.

</details>


### [141] [Joint upper-bound coverage and route-choice utility: an empirical evaluation on two urban proxy tasks](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.06995)
*Jianing Long,Xiaobin Li,Wuming Lei,Weiguang Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文用一个冻结的离线评估协议，分离速度误差、联合候选路径上界覆盖率、路径选择与最终损失，检验"更准确的交通预测或更高的不确定性覆盖率是否能改善路径决策"。结果显示，联合覆盖率提升并不等于下游路径效用提升。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 交通预测研究常假设"更准的预测"或"更高的不确定性覆盖"会自动带来更好的路径决策，但这一假设缺乏实证。本文旨在厘清预测质量指标与路径选择实际收益之间的关系。

Method: 设计冻结协议，将速度误差、联合候选路径上界覆盖率、路径选择、实际损失四者解耦。使用北京和成都的处理后道路速度数据，构建离线代理任务：每城市150个起讫点对、3条候选路径、14个测试日。对比原始90百分位路径时间上界与联合校准上界，并在最小上界路径选择规则下评估。

Result: 联合覆盖率在北京M1从83.19%升至92.26%，成都M1从75.14%升至88.33%，成都M2从74.01%升至90.64%；但C2方案反而使迟到率分别增加0.1633、0.7848、0.9200个百分点，平均行程时间增加0.588、3.082、4.418秒。在另一组成都预测器对比中，速度平均绝对误差下降14.91%时，C0下迟到率下降1.4571个百分点。

Conclusion: 在这些冻结任务中，联合覆盖率不能作为下游路径效用的替代指标；离线结果并不能确立在线或因果层面的收益。

Abstract: Whether more accurate traffic forecasts or higher uncertainty coverage improve route decisions is unclear. We evaluate this question with a frozen protocol that separates speed error, joint candidate path upper bound coverage, route selection, and realized loss. Using processed road speed data from Beijing and Chengdu, we construct offline proxy tasks with 150 origin destination pairs, three candidate paths, and 14 test days per city. We compare raw 90th percentile path time bounds with jointly calibrated upper bounds under minimum bound route choice. Joint coverage rises from 83.19% to 92.26% in Beijing M1, from 75.14% to 88.33% in Chengdu M1, and from 74.01% to 90.64% in Chengdu M2. Yet C2 increases lateness by 0.1633, 0.7848, and 0.9200 percentage points, respectively, and mean travel time by 0.588, 3.082, and 4.418 seconds. In a separate Chengdu predictor comparison, a 14.91% reduction in speed mean absolute error accompanies a 1.4571 percentage point reduction in lateness under C0. Joint coverage is therefore not a surrogate for downstream route utility in these frozen tasks the offline results do not establish online or causal benefits.

</details>


### [142] [Topology-Consistent Task Planning over Cellular Workflow Complexes for LLM-based Agents](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07004)
*Sen Zhao,Jia Tang,Ruiqi Kong,Zuyu Zhang,Lifeng Shen,Ding Zou,Xinyu He,Xu Zhang,Junwei Han*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: TopoPlanner提出一种拓扑一致的工具规划框架，将工具依赖图提升为元胞工作流复形，作为拓扑感知上下文提升LLM智能体在循环、合并等工作流模式上的规划能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有LLM智能体任务规划器擅长处理顺序或DAG类结构，但难以应对真实验证-纠正循环、分支汇聚合并、可复用中间状态等复杂工作流模式，因此需要一种能表达和推理此类拓扑结构的规划方法。

Method: TopoPlanner将工具依赖图提升为元胞工作流复形；通过余层（cosheaf）一致的元胞检索，得到与请求相关的闭子复形；在该拓扑上进行多维结构推理；并将元胞表示与规划LLM接口，用于生成工具序列。

Result: 在四个工具规划基准上，针对拓扑引导的循环、合并与循环-合并工作流，TopoPlanner在不同本地LLM骨干下均持续优于基于提示和基于图增强的基线方法。

Conclusion: 元胞拓扑建模可为LLM工具规划提供结构化上下文，有效弥补现有规划器在循环、汇聚与复用等工作流模式上的不足。

Abstract: Task planning for LLM agents requires workflows that satisfy both user intent and complex sub-task dependencies. While existing planners work well for sequential or directed acyclic graph (DAG)-like structures, they struggle with workflow patterns such as verification-correction loops, convergent branch merging, and reusable intermediate states that arise naturally in real-world tool orchestration. We present TopoPlanner, a topology-consistent planning framework that lifts tool dependency graphs into cellular workflow complexes and uses them as topologyaware context for LLM tool planning. TopoPlanner retrieves a request-relevant closed subcomplex through cosheaf-consistent cellular retrieval, performs multidimensional structural reasoning over the retrieved topology, and interfaces the resulting cellular representation with the planner LLM for tool-sequence generation. Experiments on four tool-planning benchmarks with topology-guided loop, merge, and loop-merge workflows show consistent improvements over prompt-based and graph-enhanced baselines across different local LLM backbones.

</details>


### [143] [When to Rethink: Learning Multi-Perspective Self-Verification for Vision-Language Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07018)
*Ziquan Zhu,Hanruo Zhu,Si-Yuan Lu,Morris Yu-Chao Huang,Yicheng Lin,Wei Han,Tianlong Chen,Mingyuan Wu,Hanchao Yu,Gaojie Jin,Lu Liu,Bo Sun,Tianjin Huang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文提出MOTIVE，一种多视角自验证与可靠性引导选择的重思考框架，用于提升视觉语言模型多模态推理的可靠性，无需外部评判器。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 视觉语言模型虽在多模态推理上表现强劲，但仍易生成看似合理却错误的答案。自验证是无需外部评判器即可提升答案可靠性的实用方法，但现有方法通常依赖单一验证标准或固定提示，导致可靠性估计不完整且不稳定。

Method: 作者先系统分析验证器能力与提示设计对验证性能的影响。发现更强的验证器提供更可靠的判断，且验证性能对提示选择高度敏感，没有单一提示在所有任务上始终占优。据此提出MOTIVE框架：从互补的验证视角评估每个候选答案，通过基于正确性的多视角验证学习，习得与正确性对齐的可靠性分数；推理时该分数控制"接受或重思考"决策，可靠答案直接返回，不确定答案触发历史引导的重思考。

Result: 在多种多模态基准和VLM骨干上的大量实验表明，MOTIVE持续优于强自验证与自纠正基线。进一步结果显示，可靠的验证改善了接受或重思考决策，并减少不必要的推理轮次，实现更可靠高效的自验证。

Conclusion: MOTIVE通过多视角自验证与可靠性引导选择，在不依赖外部评判器的情况下提升了多模态推理的可靠性与效率。

Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) have achieved strong performance in multimodal reasoning, yet they remain prone to generating plausible but incorrect answers. Self-verification offers a practical way to improve answer reliability without relying on external judges, but existing methods typically depend on a single verification criterion or fixed prompt, resulting in incomplete and unstable reliability estimates. We first systematically analyze how verifier capability and prompt design affect verification performance. Our findings show that stronger verifiers provide more reliable judgments, while verification performance is highly sensitive to prompt choice, with no single prompt consistently dominating across tasks. Guided by these findings, we propose \texttt{MOTIVE}, a \textbf{M}ulti-View Self-Verificati\textbf{O}n wi\textbf{T}h Rel\textbf{I}ability-Guided Selecti\textbf{VE} Rethinking framework for reliable multimodal reasoning. \texttt{MOTIVE} evaluates each candidate answer from complementary verification perspectives and learns a correctness-aligned reliability score through correctness-grounded multi-view verification learning. During inference, this score governs an accept-or-rethink decision, allowing reliable answers to be returned directly while uncertain ones trigger history-guided rethinking. Extensive experiments across diverse multimodal benchmarks and VLM backbones demonstrate that \texttt{MOTIVE} consistently outperforms strong self-verification and self-correction baselines. Further results show that reliable verification improves accept-or-rethink decisions and reduces unnecessary reasoning turns, enabling more reliable and efficient self-verification without an external judge.

</details>


### [144] [Beyond Refusal Patterns: Safe-Role Internalization for Robust and Generalizable LLM Safety Alignment](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07023)
*Jinghao Pang,Jitai Hao,Qiang Huang,Zhaochun Ren,Jun Yu*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出SSRFT框架，将安全对齐重新定义为内化预设的"安全角色"，通过角色一致的回答训练模型，实现更鲁棒、更泛化的安全对齐，同时减少对良性查询的过度拒答。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有安全对齐方法（SFT和RLHF）需要大量针对特定攻击的监督和计算资源，且存在"浅层安全对齐"和"过度拒答"问题。作者希望摆脱以拒绝为中心的对齐范式，寻找更本质的安全内化方式。

Method: SSRFT从心理测量学问题、少量越狱提示和安全角色描述构建SRQA数据集；合成、验证角色一致的回答，并将其扩展为多样化场景，使模型内化安全导向的价值观和原则，而非显式的拒绝模式。

Result: 在多种Base和Instruct模型上，SSRFT比标准SFT实现更鲁棒、更可泛化的安全对齐：对预填充攻击（prefilling attacks）鲁棒性显著更强，对未见越狱领域泛化更好，同时减少对良性查询的过度拒答，并保持模型的通用能力。

Conclusion: 安全角色内化是一种优于以拒绝为中心的安全对齐的有效替代方案。

Abstract: Large Language Models (LLMs) have achieved remarkable capabilities but remain vulnerable to jailbreak attacks that elicit harmful or unsafe outputs. Existing safety alignment approaches, including Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) and Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF), often require substantial attack-specific supervision and computational resources, while remaining susceptible to shallow safety alignment and over-refusal. To address these challenges, we introduce SSRFT(Supervised Safe-Role Fine-Tuning), the first framework that reformulates safety alignment as the internalization of a predefined safe role. SSRFT constructs a Safe-Role Question-Answer (SRQA) dataset from psychometric questions, limited jailbreak prompts, and a safe-role description. Role-consistent responses are synthesized, validated, and expanded into diverse scenarios, enabling models to internalize safety-oriented values and principles rather than explicit refusal patterns. Experiments across multiple Base and Instruct models show that SSRFT achieves more robust and generalizable safety alignment than standard SFT. SSRFT shows substantially greater robustness to prefilling attacks and better generalization to unseen jailbreak domains, while reducing over-refusal on benign queries and preserving the model's general capabilities. These results establish safe-role internalization as an effective alternative to refusal-centric safety alignment. Warning: This paper contains examples of harmful and toxic language.

</details>


### [145] [Offline AI Modules: Voice-First Offline Architecture, Hardware Reference Stack, Quantization and Benchmarking](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07026)
*Sunday Afariogun,Odunolaoluwa Jenrola,Zeinab Nezami*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 该论文对面向非洲语言社区的离线语音优先AI技术栈进行端到端基准评测，覆盖Jetson Orin NX与Raspberry Pi5两个硬件层级、三种指令微调模型与四种量化格式，结论是Q4_K_M在尺寸与质量间取得最佳平衡。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 非洲语言社区以语音为主要交互方式，且网络连接不可靠或缺失，因此需要可离线运行、低功耗、低成本且社区可及的语音优先AI系统。为此需要模块化离线架构、低成本硬件清单以及针对2-5B参数指令微调模型的可复现量化与评测流程，并通过基准评测验证其可行性。

Method: 在NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX（TierB）与Raspberry Pi5（TierA）两个硬件层级上构建首个端到端基准评测。评估三种指令微调模型在四种量化格式下的表现，部署指标包括解码吞吐、对话延迟、内存与功耗；多语言质量包括在MasakhaNEWS上对英语、豪萨语、伊博语、尼日利亚皮钦语和约鲁巴语的主题分类准确率以及各语言困惑度漂移；语音识别使用Ethio-ASR评测阿姆哈拉语和奥罗莫语。

Result: Q4_K_M量化在两个硬件层级上均呈现最佳尺寸-质量权衡。在TierB上，gemma-4-E2B-it在Q4_K_M下达到28.8 tokens/s解码吞吐与89.2%主题分类准确率；在TierA上，三种模型均可在16GB内存预算内运行。

Conclusion: 该工作验证了完全离线的语音优先AI系统在低成本、低功耗硬件上的实用部署可行性，Q4_K_M被推荐为通用部署方案，为非洲语言社区的可及性部署提供了可复现的评测基准。

Abstract: The Offline AI Modules workstream enables practical, low-power, and community-accessible deployment of voice-first AI systems that operate fully offline. Designed for African language communities where speech is the dominant mode of interaction and internet connectivity is unreliable or absent, the workstream delivers three reinforcing components: a modular voice-first offline architecture, a low-cost hardware reference bill of materials, and a reproducible quantization and a reproducible quantization and benchmarking pipeline for instruction-tuned language models in the 2-5B parameter class. This paper presents the first end-to-end benchmark evaluation of the stack across two hardware tiers: an NVIDIA Jetson Orin NX (TierB) and a Raspberry Pi5 (TierA). Three instruction-tuned models are evaluated across four quantization formats, assessed for deployment metrics (decode throughput, chat latency, memory, power) and multilingual quality (topic classification accuracy on MasakhaNEWS across English, Hausa, Igbo, Nigerian Pidgin, and Yoruba; per-language perplexity drift). Speech recognition is evaluated using Ethio-ASR on Amharic and Oromo across both tiers. The principal finding is that Q4_K_M quantization represents the best size-to-quality trade-off for deployment on both tiers: gemma-4-E2B-it achieves 28.8t/s decode throughput and 89.2% topic classification accuracy at Q4_K_M on TierB, while all three models run within the 16GB memory budget on TierA.

</details>


### [146] [JIVEAdapter: A Multi-Task Additive Low-Rank Adapter via Joint and Individual Variation Explained (JIVE)](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07036)
*Sara Abdali,Pashmina Cameron*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出 JIVEAdapter，一种受统计 JIVE 启发的多任务"加性"低秩适配器，将权重更新分解为跨任务共享的 Joint 结构与任务专属的 Individual 结构，在 GLUE/SuperGLUE 上以匹配有效秩达到与强基线相当的性能。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有低秩适配器多为单任务，且以乘性方式表示权重更新，无法显式区分跨任务共享信息与任务专属信息，缺乏可解释性与复用性。作者希望在参数高效微调中显式分离共享与任务特定信号。

Method: JIVEAdapter 将每个权重更新分解为所有任务共享的 Joint 结构加每任务的 Individual 结构；对 Individual 施加近正交于 Joint 的惩罚以保持共享与专属信号的可分离性；在共享 Joint 池与每任务 Individual 池之间自适应分配秩。Joint 可一次性联合学习，或按任务增量学习，随后冻结并作为新任务的先验复用，无需重训共享部分。

Result: 在 DeBERTaV3-base 上的 GLUE 和 SuperGLUE 中，在匹配的每任务有效秩下，JIVEAdapter 与强单任务及多任务低秩基线相当，且无需 MoE 等额外模块。当存在相关的 held-in 任务时，冻结的 Joint 可通过复用该任务的 Individual 仅加廉价的逐方向缩放来服务 held-out 任务，否则训练一个小的新 Individual。

Conclusion: JIVEAdapter 通过在低秩适配器中显式分离共享与任务专属信号，实现了可解释、可复用的多任务参数高效微调，并在标准基准上保持竞争力。

Abstract: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning adapts pretrained models at a fraction of the cost of full fine-tuning, yet most low-rank adapters are single-task and represent each weight update multiplicatively, leaving no explicit account of what is shared across tasks and what is task-specific. We introduce JIVEAdapter, a multi-task "additive" low-rank adapter inspired by statistical Joint and Individual Variation Explained (JIVE). JIVEAdapter decomposes every weight update into a Joint structure shared across all tasks plus a per-task Individual structure, penalizes the Individual structures to be near-orthogonal to the Joint so shared and task-specific signal stay "interpretable" and separated, and allocates rank adaptively across a shared Joint pool and a per-task Individual pool. The Joint is learned once, jointly over a task group or incrementally, one task at a time, then frozen and reused as a prior for new tasks without retraining the shared part. On GLUE and SuperGLUE with DeBERTaV3-base, JIVEAdapter is competitive with strong single-task and multi-task low-rank baselines at a matched per-task effective rank, without extra modules such as MoE, and when a related held-in task exists its frozen Joint serves a held-out task by reusing that task's Individual with only a cheap per-direction scale, otherwise training a small new one.

</details>


### [147] [Inference-Time Projection for Physically Valid Biomolecular Diffusion Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07037)
*Qurat-ul-ain,Yee Whye Teh,Charlotte M. Deane,Matteo Cagiada*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出两种闭式投影算子，在推理阶段直接修正AlphaFold 3类共折叠模型的去噪坐标估计，无需重训练即可同时消除链间重叠与配体几何畸变，恢复完全物理有效性且不损失结构精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: AlphaFold 3类共折叠模型虽结构预测精度高，但大量输出物理无效：界面处链重叠、配体键长键角畸变、环非平面、手性中心反转。现有方案要么用物理势引导采样器，导致采样成本与内存开销成倍增加、大复合物无法推理；要么微调模型，既耗时又把修复绑定到单一架构。

Method: 将物理有效性视为推理阶段的约束问题。观察到物理有效性可完全由采样器已持有的量在推理时验证，故在扩散模型去噪后的干净坐标估计 x̂0 上引入两个闭式投影算子：（1）链间范德华投影，推开最严重冲突的原子对；（2）配体距离几何投影，恢复键长、键角、内部接触、平面性和手性。两算子均局部、稀疏、位移有上限，无需网络评估、梯度或重要性采样，不改动去噪器及其权重，可直接嵌入任意AF3式采样器。

Result: 在Boltz-2和OpenFold-3两个独立开发的模型上，于五个基准（CASP15、CASP16、PoseBusters单体与复合物集、Boltz物理有效性测试集）验证：方法恢复完全物理有效性，同时保持结构精度与配体放置指标，运行时间和内存开销可忽略。

Conclusion: 该方法模型无关、无需重训练，为全原子结构预测提供了一条实用且通用的物理有效路径。

Abstract: AlphaFold 3-style cofolding models predict biomolecular complexes with high structural accuracy, yet a large fraction of their outputs are physically invalid: chains overlap at interfaces, ligand bond lengths and angles are distorted, rings are non-planar, and stereocentres are inverted. Current approaches either steer the sampler with physics-informed potentials, which multiplies sampling cost and memory overhead making inference impossible on large complexes, or finetune the model, costing time and tying the fix to one architecture. We observe that, unlike structural accuracy, physical validity is fully verifiable at inference time from quantities the sampler already holds. We therefore treat physical validity as a constrained inference problem and introduce two closed-form projection operators applied to the diffusion model's denoised clean-coordinate estimate, $\hat{x}_0$: an inter-chain van der Waals projection that pushes apart the most severely clashing atom pairs, and a ligand distance-geometry projection that restores bond lengths, angles, internal contacts, planarity and chirality. Both operators are local, sparse and displacement-capped, require no network evaluations, gradients or importance sampling, and leave the denoiser and its weights untouched, so they can be dropped into any AF3-style sampler without retraining. Applied to two independently developed models, Boltz-2 and OpenFold-3, across five benchmarks (CASP15, CASP16, the PoseBusters monomer and complex sets, and the Boltz physical-validity test set), our method recovers perfect physical validity while preserving structural-accuracy and ligand-placement metrics. These gains are achieved with negligible runtime and memory overhead, providing a practical, model-agnostic route to physically valid all-atom structure prediction.

</details>


### [148] [CuratorMAS: Automating Dataset Curation via Multi-Agent Orchestration](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07075)
*Yixin Zhang,Wenjie Feng*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 提出多智能体协作框架CuratorMAS，将数据策展流程分解为五个可编程阶段，实现自动化、跨域的数据集评估与筛选。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 高质量数据集对可靠机器学习至关重要，但数据策展成本高、跨领域泛化困难。现有方法依赖人工设计的启发式规则或特定模型信号，难以适用于不同任务和用户查询。

Method: CuratorMAS编排多个智能体，将复杂策展过程分解为五个可编程执行阶段并形成可并行工作流：1）数据集探索，收集文件结构与约束线索等上下文信息；2）从在线来源检索领域知识以增强评估；3）推导评估标准并计算相应指标；4）依据结果执行过滤；5）演化模块总结评估结果并更新相关技能。

Result: 大量综合实验表明，CuratorMAS将噪声率最多降低36.03个百分点，同时将下游模型F1分数最多提升8.88个百分点。

Conclusion: CuratorMAS通过多智能体协作与可编程分阶段流程，实现了灵活、自动化的数据策展，在降低数据噪声和提升下游模型性能方面均取得显著效果。

Abstract: High-quality datasets are essential for reliable machine learning, but dataset curation remains costly and hard to generalize across domains. Existing methods typically rely on manually designed heuristics or model-dependent signals, limiting their applicability across tasks and user queries. To address these limitations and automate data curation, we propose \textbf{CuratorMAS}, a multi-agent collaboration framework that orchestrates agents to evaluate and curate high-quality datasets. To achieve the goal of flexible curation, CuratorMAS decomposes the complex curation process into five programmable execution stages and forms a parallelizable workflow. Specifically, CuratorMAS first performs dataset exploration to collect contextual information such as file structures and constraint cues, thereby developing a comprehensive understanding of the given task. In order to acquire up-to-date information, CuratorMAS retrieves domain knowledge from online sources to augment the evaluation process. Next, CuratorMAS derives the necessary evaluation criteria and computes the corresponding metrics. Based on these results, CuratorMAS executes filtering accordingly. Finally, an evolution module summarizes the evaluation outcomes and updates the relevant skills. Extensive and comprehensive experiments demonstrate that CuratorMAS significantly reduces the noise rate by up to 36.03 percentage points (pp) while also improving the F1 score of downstream models by up to 8.88 pp.

</details>


### [149] [Smart Content Ingestion for Generative AI Workloads](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07091)
*Abbas Raza Ali,Muhammad Ajmal Siddiqui,Moona Zahid*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文提出一个面向企业场景的可用于生产的内容抽取系统，把抽取显式化为机器学习生命周期中的独立阶段，并通过选择性OCR路由、稀缺优先的策展与参考抽取评分、结构感知分块、只读检索评测来度量该阶段。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 生成式AI把模型与单一任务解耦，一个基础模型可服务开放式下游任务，但数据侧因此变得高度异构：企业知识以PDF、演示文稿、表格、扫描件、表单、图表等人类使用的格式撰写，同时携带文本、视觉、几何与结构信息。若在此接口处信息被错误表征，语言模型或检索器无法可靠推理，且下游重排器也无法修复其错误，因此内容抽取需成为独立的生命周期阶段。

Method: 系统包含四个组件：选择性OCR路由；采用参考抽取评分的稀缺优先策展引擎，度量字符、词与表格结构准确率；确定性的结构感知父子分块器；只读检索评测器，从每一页生成有依据的问题并报告Hit@k、平均倒数排名与延迟。

Result: 在180篇文档语料上，最佳抽取器得分97.4/100（字符错误率0.13%，表格相似度0.995）；分块器在25,050个生成问题上达到hit@1为68.6%、hit@10为92.8%、MRR为0.77。

Conclusion: 作者提炼三条设计原则（结构先于语义、绝不改动被测对象、预算化标注），并将可度量的内容抽取定位为企业代理系统的感知层。

Abstract: The evolution of machine learning has progressively changed where intelligence resides in an AI system. In conventional machine learning the task, data representation, labels and model architecture were tightly coupled, so data preparation was narrow, schema-bound and visible. Generative AI decouples the model from any single task: one foundation model serves open-ended downstream tasks, and the generality gained on the model side is matched by heterogeneity on the data side, because enterprise knowledge is authored in the formats people use (PDF, presentations, spreadsheets, scanned documents, forms, tables, diagrams and mixed-layout files) that carry textual, visual, geometric and structural information at once. A language model or retriever cannot reason reliably over information misrepresented at this interface, so content extraction becomes a lifecycle stage in its own right whose errors no downstream retriever or re-ranker can repair. This paper presents a production-ready content-extraction system that makes this stage explicit, configurable, and measurable. The system incorporates selective OCR routing, a scarcity-first curation engine with a reference-based extraction scorer that measures character, word, and table-structure accuracy, a deterministic structure-aware parent-child chunker, and a read-only retrieval evaluator that generates grounded questions from every page and reports Hit@k, mean reciprocal rank, and latency. On a 180-document corpus the best extractor scores 97.4 of 100 (character error rate 0.13%, table similarity 0.995) and the chunker reaches hit@1 of 68.6%, hit@10 of 92.8% and MRR 0.77 over 25,050 generated questions. We distil three design principles (structure before semantics, never mutate what you measure, budget your labels) and position measured content extraction as the perception layer of enterprise agentic systems.

</details>


### [150] [Small Language Models for Smart Data Model Classification at the Edge: A Cost-Aware Hybrid Approach](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07093)
*Cristian Martella,Angelo Martella,Antonella Longo,Motaz Saad*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文评估轻量级开源语言模型在资源受限边缘环境下，将IoT数据实体映射到最佳智能数据模型（SDM）的性能，并与近零成本相似度基线对比。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: IoT跨域异构数据源快速增长，需要高效可扩展的数据标准化方法。SDM分类对实现互操作性至关重要，但现有方法资源消耗高，难以适用于计算能力受限的边缘环境，文献中缺乏轻量级、资源高效的解决方案。

Method: 系统性地基准测试多种轻量级开源语言模型，涵盖通用型（GP）、推理专用型（RS）和代码专用型（CS）架构，在多个领域特定数据集上完成数据实体到最匹配SDM表示的分类任务；同时开展补充实验，将所调查的大语言模型与两种近零成本相似度基线（TF-IDF和轻量级句编码器）在同一任务上进行比较。

Result: 在不同模型架构和数据集上获得了关于模型选择、任务构建与部署策略的性能表现，并提供了LLM方法与近零成本相似度基线的对比参考点，用于判断LLM分类在边缘平台上的实际价值。

Conclusion: 研究为资源受限条件下优化准确率与效率的模型选择、任务构建和部署策略提供了重要洞见，弥补了轻量级、资源高效SDM分类方案的文献空白，并为边缘平台LLM分类的实际价值提供了参考依据。

Abstract: The rapid proliferation of heterogeneous data sources within the Internet of Things (IoT) across domains such as smart cities, energy management, and environmental monitoring necessitates efficient and scalable data standardization methods. Effective classification of smart data models (SDMs) is essential for facilitating interoperability. However, existing approaches are often limited by high resource consumption and lack applicability in edge environments with constrained computational capabilities. Aiming to bridge this gap, the proposed study evaluates the performance of lightweight open-source language models (LMs) to resolve an input data entity against its corresponding best fitting SDM representation under resource-constrained conditions. It systematically benchmarks a diverse array of models, including general purpose (GP), reasoning-specialized (RS), and code-specialized (CS) architectures, across multiple domain-specific datasets. Addressing the current omission of lightweight, resource-efficient solutions in the literature, the investigation provides significant and valuable insights into model selection, task formulation, and deployment strategies that optimize accuracy and efficiency. A complementary experiment also compares the surveyed large language models (LLMs) against two near-zero-cost similarity baselines (Term Frequency-Inverse Document Frequency (TF-IDF) and a lightweight sentence encoder) on the same task, providing a strong reference point for interpreting the practical value of LLM-based classification on edge platforms.

</details>


### [151] [Verified, not generated: expert-verified AI study materials and the distribution of learning gains in a university course](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07097)
*Canh Thien Dang,An Nguyen*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 在强制大一经济学课程中提供经助教核验的AI生成学习资源，可使学生获得平均2.34分（满分50）优势，且收益集中于低分学生，主要体现为跨越及格/等级门槛。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 已有生成式AI教育研究多报告平均效应，但实地证据显示AI既可能缩小也可能扩大成绩差距。作者认为方向取决于"判断负担"——学习者在接受AI内容学习前须自行筛查其可靠性所需的专业能力，并主张由可问责的助教在发布前进行专家核验可将该负担从学生转移到教师一侧。

Method: 采用两届学生的双重差分设计。在强制大一经济学课程中，一半学生获得AI生成的播客、FAQ与测验式学习指南，内容由基于源材料的模型生成并经具名研究生助教核验（共170名学生，340份考试成绩）。同时开展36名学生的访谈与反馈分析。

Result: 获得资源与50分制组成部分中2.34分的优势相关。低于二等上等级界限的成绩占比相对反事实下降24.7个百分点；效应在23至31分各阈值上均显著，更高阈值均不显著；约四分之三的平均效应来自最低五分位学生。阈值估计在剔除干预前队列中最低分学生后仍稳健，但平均效应不稳健。访谈显示核验标签让学生有理由接触AI材料，同时未放弃对其的审视。

Conclusion: 仅报告平均效应的AI学习资源评估无法识别资源本应帮助的学生是否真正获益；核验机制与分布效应分析对判断AI是否缩小差距至关重要。

Abstract: Experimental studies of generative AI in education mostly report average effects, yet field evidence shows that AI can narrow attainment gaps or widen them. We argue that the direction depends on the judgement burden, the expertise a learner must supply to screen AI output before learning from it, and that expert verification before release moves this burden from students to an accountable tutor. We test the argument in a two-cohort difference-in-differences design in which one half of a compulsory firstyear university economics course received AI-generated podcasts, FAQs and quiz-based study guides, produced with a source-grounded model and checked by a named graduate teaching assistant (170 students; 340 examination marks). Access was associated with a 2.34-mark advantage on a 50-mark component. The share of marks below the upper-second classification boundary fell by 24.7 percentage points relative to the counterfactual, effects were significant at every threshold from 23 to 31 marks and at none above, and roughly three-quarters of the average originated in the bottom quintile. The threshold estimate is robust to removing the lowest-scoring students from the pre-intervention cohort; the average effect is not. Interviews and feedback from 36 students indicate that the verification label gave students a reason to engage with AI-generated material without ending their scrutiny of it. Evaluations of AI learning resources that report only mean effects cannot detect whether the students the resources are meant to help are the ones who gain.

</details>


### [152] [When to Remember, When to Abstain: Category-Conditioned Retention for Reliable Agent Memory](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07100)
*Olukunle Owolabi,Pulkit Gupta,Fei Wang*

Main category: cs.AI

TL;DR: 本文将记忆保留决策从全局置信阈值改为按断言语义类别条件化的阈值，实验显示按类别设阈可在保持覆盖率的同时降低无支撑保留。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 代理长期记忆的可靠性取决于"保留决策"：来源支撑较弱的断言一旦被写入，之后就会被当作既定事实复用。论文发现不同语义类别的断言可靠性存在显著不对称——价值与信念类断言仅77.9%被来源支撑，而其他类别达96.2%——单一全局阈值无法同时兼顾两者，因此需要按类别设阈。

Method: 在已部署的冷启动记忆流水线上，对100个合成角色（persona）进行评测。以4,715条候选断言为分析对象，比较全局置信阈值与按语义类别条件化的阈值策略：对证据充分的类别宽松保留，对推理不可靠的类别更积极弃权（在写入边界实现选择性预测）。通过重复的留出（held-out）评估验证稳定性。

Result: 仅对价值类断言采用更严格的阈值，可将无支撑保留率从6.2%降至4.0%（约36%的相对下降，幅度不大但在各折上一致）；作为佐证，在相近保留量下，其覆盖率比全局阈值高出约13个百分点（95% CI 9.8–16.0）。

Conclusion: 可靠的记忆保留取决于断言的类型而非仅凭置信度；按类别条件化的阈值可作为一种简单有效的"选择性预测"机制，作用于记忆写入边界。

Abstract: Persistent agent memory is only as reliable as its retention decision: an assertion weakly supported by its source can be stored and later reused as established fact.
