On the manipulation task, node-local Shared-KV improved joint decision accuracy from 75% to 94% and closed-loop success from 0% to 60%. Fixed-score policy replay showed that stage gating prevented out-of-order actions and external postconditions prevented premature completion.

</details>


### [499] [ScanSTL: Parallel Robustness Evaluation for Signal Temporal Logic](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07346)
*Gokhan Alcan*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: ScanSTL 通过结合关联式时间聚合、并行扫描与有序块归约，实现了 STL 鲁棒性的高效并行评估与微分，在 CPU/GPU 上大幅加速。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: STL 鲁棒性的反复评估与微分是机器人规划与控制中的计算瓶颈：时序递推限制并行性，密集掩码增加内存开销。

Method: 将关联式时间聚合与并行扫描、有序块归约结合；Eventually 和 Always 采用区间极值，包含式强 Until 组合紧凑段表示；统一区间引擎处理有界与平移区间及延迟 Until 见证前置守卫；基于 JAX 开源实现，支持自动微分、批处理和编译。

Result: 每个精确实时算子以线性工作量与存储、对数并行深度计算完整鲁棒性轨迹。512 样本下九个规格的 CPU 几何平均加速为前向 243 倍、梯度 104 倍（对比 STLCG++）；RTX 5090 上对超两百万样本的无界 Until，前向中位时间低于 0.1 ms，梯度低于 0.25 ms；机器狗护送与巡逻仿真显示更快的违规规划修复和更强 MPC 求解能力。

Conclusion: ScanSTL 在保持精确性与可微性的同时显著提升 STL 评估效率，适用于机器人规划与控制的实时需求。

Abstract: Repeated evaluation and differentiation of Signal Temporal Logic (STL) robustness can become a computational bottleneck in robot planning and control. Sequential temporal recurrences limit parallelism, while dense masking increases memory requirements. We propose ScanSTL, which combines associative temporal aggregation with parallel scans and ordered block reductions. Eventually and Always use range extrema, while inclusive strong Until composes compact segment representations. A common range engine handles bounded and shifted intervals, including the guards required before delayed Until witnesses. Each exact temporal operator computes complete robustness traces with linear work and storage and logarithmic parallel depth on uniformly sampled finite signals. An open source JAX implementation supports automatic differentiation, batching, and compilation. We compare ScanSTL with STLCG and STLCG++ using CPU and GPU operator benchmarks and nine composed specifications. Across these nine specifications at 512 samples, ScanSTL achieves geometric mean speedups of 243 times for forward evaluation and 104 times for gradient computation over STLCG++ in JAX on the CPU. On an RTX~5090 GPU, ScanSTL evaluates unbounded Until over more than two million samples with median times below 0.1 ms for forward evaluation and 0.25 ms for gradient computation. Simulated escort and patrol experiments with a robot dog further demonstrate faster repair of violating plans and greater solver capacity in model predictive control.

</details>


### [500] [Expressiveness, Equivalence, and Uncertainty in Velocity Obstacles and Closest Point of Approach Metrics](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07371)
*Elizabeth Dietrich,Liam M. Imagawa,Hanna Krasowski,Aurora Haraldsen,Murat Arcak,Kristin Y. Pettersen*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该文建立了TCPA、DCPA与速度障碍(VO)之间的关系，并分析其在不确定性下的行为，指出在有界不确定性下独立计算的TCPA/DCPA界限会丢失VO所需的联合关系，而考虑不确定性的VO能保持该关系。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: TCPA、DCPA和VO广泛用于自主导航中的碰撞风险评估，但它们之间的关系以及在不确定性下的行为尚未被充分研究。

Method: 在完美状态信息假设下，建立这些表示在有限和无限预测时域上的关系，推导它们等价刻画碰撞风险的条件；在有界不确定性下，将CPA指标和VO扩展到凸的相对状态集。

Result: 证明了在有界不确定性下，独立计算的TCPA和DCPA界限会失去VO隶属所需的联合关系；而考虑不确定性的VO通过碰撞诱导速度的集合值表示保持了该关系。

Conclusion: 不确定性感知的VO以集合值形式保留了碰撞风险的联合刻画，而独立的TCPA/DCPA界限则无法做到这一点。

Abstract: Time to Closest Point of Approach (TCPA), Distance to Closest Point of Approach (DCPA), and Velocity Obstacles (VOs), are widely used to assess and mitigate collision risk in autonomous navigation, yet their relationship and behavior under uncertainty remain largely unexplored. Assuming perfect state information, we establish a relationship between these representations over finite and infinite prediction horizons and derive conditions under which they provide equivalent characterizations of collision risk. Under bounded uncertainty, we extend the Closest Point of Approach (CPA) metrics and VO to convex relative-state sets. We show that in this setting, independently computed TCPA and DCPA bounds lose the joint relationship required for VO membership, while uncertainty-aware VOs preserve this relationship through a set-valued representation of collision-inducing velocities.

</details>


### [501] [Toward Trustworthy Physical AI for Human Interaction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07382)
*Niccolò Pagliarani,Maximilian Stölzle,Cosima du Pasquier,Jeff Lui,Andrew Sabelhaus,Cecilia Laschi,Gentiane Venture,Daniela Rus,Matteo Cianchetti*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该论文提出面向可信物理人工智能的框架，将安全性、行为可理解性与感知一致性在具身、控制、认知与设计四个层面整合，认为可信度源于物理能力、可观察行为与人机交互中形成的期望之间的对齐。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人进入人类生活空间的速度快于我们建立其可信度评判标准的速度，因此亟需一套系统性的可信物理AI框架来界定机器人何时值得信任。

Method: 提出一个整合式框架，在具身、控制、认知与设计四个层面统一安全（Safety）、行为可理解性（Behavioral Intelligibility）与感知一致性（Perceptual Alignment）三个维度。

Result: 摘要未报告具体实验结果或量化指标，主要为概念性框架的构建与论证。

Conclusion: 可信度并非单一属性，而是由物理能力、可观察行为与人类在交互中形成的期望三者对齐而涌现的结果。

Abstract: Robots are entering human spaces faster than we can establish when they deserve trust. We propose a framework for trustworthy physical AI that integrates Safety, Behavioral Intelligibility, and Perceptual Alignment across embodiment, control, cognition, and design. Trustworthiness emerges from aligning physical capabilities, observable behavior, and expectations people form during interaction.

</details>


### [502] [AeroBuoy: A Drone Deployable, 3D Printed, Autonomous Robotic Buoy for Environmental Inspection in Remote and Hazardous River Systems](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07390)
*Reuben O'Brien,Angus Lynch,Minas Liarokapis*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出一种由无人机部署的自主数据采集浮标，利用河流自然水流与GPS/磁力计导航实现自主航行，用于偏远危险水域的环境监测，并在新西兰奥克兰Ōrewa河完成系统演示。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 偏远、危险或受保护的河流水体监测对评估施工径流、气候变化等外部因素影响十分重要。现有自主无人船虽能提供环境巡检方案，但在机动性方面存在不足，且难以进入不可达河段。

Method: 设计一种可由无人机投放与回收的自主数据采集浮标系统；浮标借助河流自然水流自主下漂，使用GPS与磁力计保持期望轨迹；可搭载水温、溶氧、声呐河床探测、浊度等多种传感器；论文给出系统设计并对浮标自扶正能力进行分析。

Result: 开展了浮标自扶正能力分析，并在新西兰奥克兰Ōrewa河进行了完整系统演示。

Conclusion: 该无人机部署浮标系统可作为一种灵活的环境巡检手段，适用于难以进入的河流系统，并可按具体位置与监测任务需求进行投放和回收。

Abstract: Monitoring of waterways such as remote and hazardous rivers and streams is important so as to assess the impact of external factors including construction runoff or climate change. Versatile, autonomous robotic boats can offer excellent environmental inspection and monitoring solutions for remote, dangerous, or access protected water bodies but they have several shortcomings in terms of maneuverability. This paper proposes an environmental inspection system consisting of an autonomous data collection buoy which is designed to be deployed to inaccessible river systems using a drone. The system can perform a drop off and pickup of the buoy depending on the requirements of a particular location and monitoring task. Utilising the natural flow of the river the buoy autonomously steers down, using GPS and magnetometers so as to maintain the desired trajectory. The buoy is capable of measuring water temperature but it can also be equipped with a range of sensors such as water oxygen meter, sonar for river bed inspection, or turbidity for water clarity. This paper describes the system design, presents an analysis of the self-righting capabilities of the buoy, and shows a full system demonstration at the Ōrewa River in Auckland, New Zealand.

</details>


### [503] [What the Elevation Map Cannot See: Semantic-Aware Locomotion and Execution-Aware Navigation for Humanoid Robot](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07396)
*Shunyu Yao,Songyang Liu,Dinghao Chen,Yuanyuan Lei,Shuai Li*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该论文提出一个新基准，同时建模"高程图难以表达的隐蔽危险"和"运动执行偏差"，并给出闭环VLN+运动控制框架，在仿真评估并在Unitree G1实体人形机器人上验证运动策略。结果表明语义输入可减少与隐蔽危险物的接触，抗偏差机制可提升导航成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有VLN基准虽能实现物理可执行的导航，但存在两个不现实假设：(1)所有危险都能从高程图中观察到；(2)实际运动与期望运动高度一致。真实环境中，倒地瓶子在高程图中难以分辨，手机与水渍也难以区分；运动策略避障会导致实际轨迹偏离VLN策略预期路径，这种"命令-执行不匹配"会累积并使机器人偏离目标。因此需要暴露这些失效模式。

Method: 提出一个同时建模高程隐蔽危险（elevation-subtle hazards）与执行偏差的仿真基准；并设计一个闭环的VLN + 运动控制框架，持续将高层导航与机器人实际状态重新对齐。在仿真中进行导航评估，并在实体Unitree G1人形机器人上验证运动策略。

Result: 语义输入的引入减少了机器人与高程图中难以表示的危险物的接触；抗偏差机制提升了导航成功率。

Conclusion: 人形机器人导航评估应同时考虑路径完成度与危险规避两方面，仅依赖高程图与理想执行假设的基准不足以反映真实部署中的风险。

Abstract: Navigation for humanoid robots is critical, yet large-scale evaluation on physical hardware is often impractical due to cost and safety concerns, making simulation benchmarks essential. Existing VLN benchmarks achieve physically executable navigation, but still assume (1) all hazards are observable from elevation maps; (2) realized motions closely match desired motions. In real environments, however, fallen bottles may be ambiguous in elevation maps, while phones and water spills may be difficult to differentiate; hazard avoidance by the locomotion policy can cause the robot's actual trajectory to deviate from the path intended by the VLN policy. Such command-execution mismatch can accumulate and lead the robot toward unintended locations. To expose these failure modes, we introduce a benchmark that models both elevation-subtle hazards and execution deviations, together with a closed-loop VLN + locomotion control framework that continuously realigns high-level navigation with the robot's actual state. We evaluate navigation in simulation and further validate the locomotion policy on a physical Unitree G1 humanoid robot. Results show that semantic input reduces contact with hazards poorly represented in elevation maps, while anti-deviation improves navigation success. These findings highlight the need to evaluate humanoid navigation jointly in terms of route completion and hazard avoidance.

</details>


### [504] [An Autonomous, 3D Printed, Waterjet-Powered, Open-Source Robotic Trimaran for Environmental Inspection and Monitoring](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07398)
*Reuben O'Brien,Martin Lambrechtse-Reid,Minas Liarokapis*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出一种低成本、可复现的自主喷水推进三体无人船平台，用于偏远或受保护水体的环境监测，重小于5 kg、成本600–1500美元、最高航速2 m/s，并在水深测量与水质检测中表现优异。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 偏远、危险、难以到达或受保护的水体缺乏高效的水环境巡检与监测手段，传统科考船资源消耗大、成本高。特别是新西兰（Aotearoa）多样水域环境，亟需一种高效、低成本、易复制的自主监测方案。

Method: 设计并实现一艘自主、低成本、喷水推进的三体无人船：采用商用现成组件与3D打印技术制造，集成传感系统（支持水深测量与水质测试），并具备对岩石等自然障碍物的避障能力。

Result: 平台开发成本约600–1500美元（取决于传感配置），重量小于5 kg，最高航速2 m/s，可在浅水区作业并实现障碍物规避；论文给出了设计特性、传感系统及以水深测量为重点的测试结果。

Conclusion: 该三体无人船具备良好的可复现性与鲁棒性，为高效水环境监测提供了低成本替代方案，并为未来数据采集与研究奠定基础。

Abstract: Versatile, autonomous robotic boats can offer excellent environmental inspection and monitoring solutions for remote, dangerous, hard to reach, or access protected water bodies. This paper introduces such a platform in the form of an autonomous, cost-effective, waterjet-powered robotic trimaran. Motivated by the need for an efficient aquatic monitoring, particularly in Aotearoa - New Zealand's diverse environments, the trimaran provides an efficient, low-cost, and easy to replicate alternative to resource-intensive research vessels. The proposed platform, costs $600-1,500 USD to develop (depending on the sensing system configuration), weighs under 5 kg, and excels in bathymetry and water quality testing. The trimaran can reach speeds of up to 2 m/s offering obstacle avoidance of natural features, such as rocks. Utilizing off-the-shelf components and 3D printing technology, the proposed platform offers excellent reproducibility and robustness while operating in shallow waters with its jet propulsion system. The paper presents in detail the design characteristics, the sensing system employed, testing results focusing on bathymetry, and highlights the ability of vessel and the potential for future research and data collection.

</details>


### [505] [RACER: Residual-Adaptive Closed-Loop Estimation for Sampling-Based Planning in Wheeled-Quadruped Racing](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07409)
*Yuxiang Liu,Marla Eisman,Lizhi Yang,Aaron Ames,Francesco Borrelli*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出RACER分层控制框架，将MPPI规划器、学习到的残差动力学模型与低层RL速度跟踪器结合，用于轮式四足机器人竞速，并提出LoRRA两阶段残差自适应方法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 轮式四足机器人高速竞速中，RL速度跟踪器的闭环跟踪行为难以用简单标称运动学模型（如独轮车模型）准确描述，尤其在高速转弯时存在明显跟踪误差，且真实世界数据有限，难以直接训练残差模型。

Method: 在标称独轮车运动学模型上增加神经残差项以捕捉RL策略的闭环跟踪行为；提出LoRRA（低秩残差自适应）两阶段方法：先在大规模仿真数据上预训练以获得广泛覆盖，再在小规模真实数据上用低秩约束微调。

Result: 仿真中验证三点：(A) 残差动力学通过捕捉高速转弯时RL速度跟踪器的跟踪误差提升整体性能；(B) 用源域和目标域数据共同训练的残差动力学显著优于仅用目标域数据训练；(C) 当地面系数或关节增益域差距增大时，低秩约束的目标域自适应比全量微调和从头训练成功率更高、性能更好。

Conclusion: RACER框架结合残差动力学与LoRRA低秩自适应，有效提升了轮式四足机器人竞速的控制性能与跨域泛化能力，证明了残差建模和低秩微调在有限真实数据下的优越性。

Abstract: We present RACER, a hierarchical control framework for wheel-based quadruped racing that combines an MPPI planner with a learned residual dynamics model and a low-level RL velocity tracker. The planner augments a nominal unicycle kinematic model with a neural residual term to capture the closed-loop tracking behavior of the RL policy. To train this residual model under limited real-world data, we propose Low-Rank Residual Adaptation (LoRRA), a two-stage approach that pre-trains on large-scale simulation data for broad coverage and then fine-tunes on a small real-world dataset with a low-rank constraint. In simulation, we empirically validate our engineering choices by showing (A) Residual dynamics improve the overall performance of our pipeline by capturing the tracking error of RL velocity tracker at high-speed cornering. (B) Residual dynamics trained with both source-domain and target-domain data gives racing performance significantly better than the residual dynamics trained with only target-domain data. (C) Low-rank constraint at target-domain adaptation gives higher success rates and higher performance than full-tune and from-scratch when domain gap in ground coefficient or joint gain increases.

</details>


### [506] [Entropy-Gated Belief Coordination for Decentralized Multi-Agent Search Under Intermittent Communication](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07432)
*Mohamed Abdelnaby,Kevin Leahy*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出熵门控信念协调机制，仅在利用阶段融合信念，在多智能体目标搜索中显著提升信念质量。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 多智能体目标搜索中，智能体间歇通信（泊松时序）。传统无条件信念融合在高熵探索阶段强行同步，浪费通信机会并导致过早共识，丧失独立探索的覆盖优势。

Method: 引入熵门控信念协调：集体熵比超过阈值θ时跳过融合，仅在利用阶段合并，依据非线性意见动力学的分岔结构与逐步信息增益目标的次模结构。推导步骤互信息Istep(α,β)作为无通信的可解释传感器信息量度量。提出EG-TDP规划器，在利用模式加入检测概率规划器切换。

Result: 103,680次实验（9种栅格至100×100、泊松通信时序、4种目标运动模式）显示EG-TDP平均信念质量Q̄=0.300，较算术平均提升58.9%，较访问加权融合提升37.4%。在代表性配置中，仅靠随机间歇接触即优于每步使用全部观测的联合贝叶斯参考。

Conclusion: 熵门控融合优于无条件融合，间歇通信下可超越全观测联合贝叶斯参考量，验证门控设计的有效性。

Abstract: We study decentralized multi-agent target search where homogeneous agents communicate intermittently at Poisson-distributed times. Standard unconditional belief fusion wastes communication opportunities by synchronizing agents during high-entropy exploration, when diverse independent beliefs provide better coverage than a premature consensus. We introduce \emph{entropy-gated belief coordination}, in which agents skip fusion while their collective entropy ratio exceeds a threshold~\(θ\) and merge only during exploitation, consistent with the bifurcation structure of nonlinear opinion dynamics and the submodular structure of the per-step information gain objective. We further derive \(\Istep(α,β)\), the expected mutual information per observation step between two agents' binary sensors, as an interpretable, communication-free measure of sensor informativeness that motivates the gating design and guides system-level analysis. Experiments across 103{,}680 trials (nine grid sizes up to \(100{\times}100\), Poisson communication timing, four target movement patterns) show that the Entropy-Gated Trust-Decay Planner (\textsc{EG-TDP}), which adds a detection-probability planner switch in exploitation mode, achieves mean belief quality \(\bar{Q}=0.300\) (mean belief mass at the true target cell, averaged across all trials and steps), a \(58.9\%\) gain over arithmetic mean and a \(37.4\%\) gain over visit-weighted fusion. On representative configurations, EG-TDP also outperforms a joint-Bayesian reference that uses all agents'~observations at every step, despite operating under random intermittent contact only.

</details>


### [507] [Dynamics Modeling of a Multi-UAV Slung Load System Using a Discrete-Link Cable Approach](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07456)
*Harvey Merton,Ian W. Hunter*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该论文提出一种基于Euler-Newton的多刚体链式缆绳动力学模型，用于多无人机吊挂负载系统（MUSLS），可借助Featherstone铰接体算法高效仿真，并通过实飞数据与参数扫描验证了模型精度。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有MUSLS控制研究常将柔性缆绳简化为无质量刚性杆，这一假设可能损失模型的真实性与精度，因此需要能够刻画缆绳柔性的替代动力学模型，同时兼顾计算效率。

Method: 采用Euler-Newton方法推导动力学模型，用一系列刚性连杆来近似表示柔性缆绳，并专门设计为可借助Featherstone铰接体算法进行高效仿真；随后在温和、剧烈以及张力介入等机动条件下开展实飞验证，并通过参数扫描确定连杆数量、关节阻尼与关节摩擦的最佳取值。

Result: 模型与真实飞行数据高度吻合，负载平移误差均值低于132毫米（约缆绳长度的5.5%），姿态误差低于11.4度。同时作者将真实飞行数据公开，以供未来缆绳模型开发使用。

Conclusion: 用多连杆链式模型替代无质量刚性杆假设，能够在保持仿真效率的同时显著提升MUSLS动力学模型的真实性与保真度，公开数据也有助后续研究。

Abstract: A common assumption to simplify the problem of controlling a multi-UAV slung load system (MUSLS) is that the flexible cables can be modeled as massless rigid rods. In this work, we propose an alternative Euler-Newton derived dynamical model which uses a series of rigid links to model the flexible cables. The model is specifically designed to allow efficient simulation using Featherstone's articulated body algorithm. We perform real-world validation of this model on gentle, aggressive, and tension-engagement maneuvers and run a parameter sweep to determine the number of links, joint damping, and joint friction to achieve the greatest model fidelity. The model closely matches real-world flight data with mean load translation errors below 132 mm (5.5% of the cable length) and orientation errors below 11.4 degrees. We make the real-world flight data publicly available for the development of future cable models.

</details>


### [508] [SURGE: Sonar-fUsed Reconstruction and localization via image-gated Graph Estimation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07472)
*Mohammed Ibrahim M,Vallabh Deogaonkar,Trung Dong,Jane Shin,Abhilash Somayajula,Xiaomin Lin*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: SURGE 是一个相机-声呐联合框架，在因子图中融合视觉与声学观测，联合估计 ROV 轨迹与目标位置，并利用恢复的度量位姿进行声呐高斯泼溅，实现比纯视觉位姿估计更一致的定位和原生度量、更紧凑的重建。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: ROV 在水下洞穴、沉船和水下设施的探测任务需要准确的三维环境理解，这依赖于可靠的载具定位和度量场景重建。但水下常无外部定位，小型 ROV 只能依赖机载感知。光学视觉信息丰富却存在尺度模糊和轨迹漂移，二维成像声呐提供度量距离但三维几何不完整。现有方法通常分别处理这些局限或假设已知传感器位姿，导致定位与重建相互脱节。

Method: 提出 SURGE，一个相机-声呐框架：在因子图中整合视觉与声学观测，联合估计 ROV 轨迹和目标位置；随后利用恢复的度量位姿进行声呐高斯泼溅重建。

Result: 在真实水下 RGB-声呐观测上的实验表明，SURGE 相比传统基于视觉的位姿估计显著提升了定位一致性，并产生比 RGB 高斯泼溅基线更紧凑、原生度量的重建结果。

Conclusion: SURGE 通过将视觉与声学观测在因子图中联合优化，弥合了水下定位与重建之间的脱节，实现了更一致的水下定位和更紧凑的度量重建。

Abstract: Remotely operated vehicles (ROVs) are widely used to explore and inspect underwater environments such as caves, shipwrecks, and submerged infrastructure. These missions require accurate 3D understanding of the surrounding environment, which depends on both reliable vehicle localization and metric scene reconstruction. However, external positioning is often unavailable underwater, requiring small ROVs to rely primarily on onboard perception. Optic vision provides rich visual and geometric information but suffers from scale ambi- guity and trajectory drift, whereas 2D imaging sonar provides metric range but incomplete 3D geometry. Existing underwater reconstruction approaches typically address these limitations separately or assume known sensor poses, leaving localization and reconstruction disconnected. We present SURGE, a camera sonar framework that jointly estimates the ROV trajectory and target location by integrating visual and acoustic observations within a factor graph, then uses the recovered metric poses for sonar Gaussian splatting. Experiments on real underwater RGB sonar observations show that SURGE substantially improves localization consistency over conventional vision based pose estimation and produces a more compact, natively metric reconstruction than RGB Gaussian splatting baselines.

</details>


### [509] [Risk-Sensitive Crowd Navigation with Adaptive Ellipsoidal Conformal Prediction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07474)
*Ruihan A. Li,Ziyao Guo,Yingying Li*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出一种风险感知的人群导航框架，利用各向异性共形椭球将结构化预测不确定性转化为回合级CVaR信号，并用以调节拉格朗日安全惩罚，从而在分布偏移下实现安全导航。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 分布偏移下的人群导航需要能够刻画结构化人体运动预测误差的不确定性表示，以及能够应对稀有但后果严重失败的安全目标。现有不确定性感知方法通常用各向同性区域表示预测误差，要么过于保守，要么与方向性运动不确定性对齐不佳。

Method: 采用自适应椭球共形预测（AECP）捕捉方向性预测误差，并在分布偏移下自适应校准不确定性区域；将结构化预测不确定性转化为回合级条件风险价值（CVaR）信号，用以调节拉格朗日安全惩罚；最终使用拉格朗日近端策略优化（Lagrangian PPO）优化导航策略。

Result: 在分布内与分布外（OOD）设置（含行人运动模式偏移）下评估。与最先进基线相比，方法保持有竞争力的分布内性能，同时在OOD设置中成功率提升5.68–7.44个百分点，碰撞率降低5.44–6.64个百分点。此外，训练策略无需微调即部署于搭载机载感知、仅CPU推理的实体机器人上，验证了完整流程在物理人群导航中的可行性。

Conclusion: 各向异性共形椭球与CVaR调节的拉格朗日安全机制能够有效应对分布偏移下的人群导航安全问题，并具备从仿真到实体机器人的实际部署可行性。

Abstract: Safe crowd navigation under distribution shift requires uncertainty representations that capture structured human-motion prediction errors and safety objectives that account for rare but consequential failures. Existing uncertainty-aware methods typically represent prediction errors using isotropic regions, which can be either overly conservative or poorly aligned with directional motion uncertainty. We introduce a risk-aware navigation framework that uses anisotropic conformal ellipsoids to translate structured prediction uncertainty into an episode-level conditional value-at-risk (CVaR) signal that regulates the Lagrangian safety penalty. In particular, adaptive ellipsoidal conformal prediction (AECP) captures directional prediction errors and adaptively calibrates uncertainty regions under distribution shift, while the resulting CVaR-regulated navigation policy is optimized using Lagrangian proximal policy optimization. We evaluate our proposed method under both in-distribution settings and out-of-distribution (OOD) settings involving shifts in pedestrian motion patterns. Compared with state-of-the-art baselines, our method maintains competitive in-distribution performance while improving success rates by 5.68-7.44 percentage points and reducing collision rates by 5.44-6.64 percentage points across OOD settings. We further deploy the trained policy without fine-tuning on a physical robot with onboard perception and CPU-only inference, showing that the full pipeline is feasible in physical crowd navigation.

</details>


### [510] [MobileVISTA: Generative Data Augmentation for Pose Generalization in Mobile Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07511)
*Suzannah Wistreich,Stephen Tian,Isabella Huang,Vitor Campagnolo Guizilini,Sergey Zakharov,Katherine Liu,Jiajun Wu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: MobileVISTA 是一个数据生成框架，通过联合增强自我中心视觉观测与重定向动作，将固定位姿采集的演示转化为多样化的位姿扰动训练数据，提升移动操作机器人的策略鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 端到端模仿学习策略在单一机器人位姿下训练，部署时即使厘米级的位姿偏差也会导致自我中心观测和末端执行器轨迹超出训练分布，性能急剧下降。现有方法假设相机刚性安装于驱动链之外或机器人本体大部分在画面之外，无法适用于相机既受运动学链影响又需观测该链的自我中心平台（如人形机器人）。

Method: MobileVISTA 将规范位姿下采集的演示转换为多样化的位姿扰动训练数据，具体通过两步联合实现：（1）增强自我中心视觉观测；（2）重定向动作以补偿基座位姿变化。该方法专门针对相机随驱动链运动并观测机器人本体的自我中心平台设计，无需额外采集演示或训练生成模型。

Result: 在涵盖人形与双臂形态的仿真任务以及真实 Galaxea R1 Pro 平台上进行验证。结果显示：使用 MobileVISTA 增强数据训练的策略对测试时先前分布外的位姿展现出更强的鲁棒性；且该方法的收益在测试的人形机器人上最大，因为此时相机随驱动链运动、机器人占据画面大部分区域。

Conclusion: MobileVISTA 无需额外演示采集或生成模型，即可有效提升移动操作策略对位姿偏移的鲁棒性，尤其在相机随驱动链运动的自我中心人形平台上效果最为显著。

Abstract: Mobile manipulators such as humanoid robots are increasingly deployed in dynamic, unstructured environments to perform dexterous manipulation tasks. However, end-to-end manipulation policies trained to imitate demonstration data collected from a single robot pose are brittle: even centimeter-scale deviations in robot pose at deployment can drive ego-centric observations and end-effector trajectories out of the training distribution, leading to sharp drops in performance. We introduce MobileVISTA, a data generation framework that transforms demonstrations captured at canonical poses into diverse, pose-perturbed training data by jointly (1) augmenting egocentric visual observations and (2) retargeting actions to compensate for base pose changes. Unlike prior methods, which assume a camera rigidly mounted off the actuated chain or non-trivial articulated robot geometry largely out of frame, MobileVISTA targets compatibility with egocentric platforms (e.g., humanoids) where the camera is both influenced by and must observe the robot's kinematic chain as it moves. We study MobileVISTA in simulated tasks spanning humanoid and bimanual embodiments, and on a real Galaxea R1 Pro. We find policies trained on MobileVISTA-augmented data demonstrate improved robustness to previously out-of-distribution poses encountered at test time, without additional demonstration collection or a trained generative model. Additionally, we find MobileVISTA's benefit is largest on tested humanoids, where the camera rides the actuated chain and the robot fills much of the frame. Additional videos and appendix can be found on our website: https://mobilevista.github.io

</details>


### [511] [ProCut: Probabilistic Cutting Topology for Autonomous Electrosurgical Tissue Dissection](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07515)
*Xiao Liang,Fei Liu,Florian Richter,Genie Rubaiyat,Michael Yip*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出一个全可微框架，通过连续sigmoid平滑组织切割的离散事件，结合可微PBD仿真与SVGD概率推断，实现软组织变形追踪中的拓扑变化建模，并开发了薄壳组织自主切割算法。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 软组织变形追踪对介入和外科手术至关重要，但现有方法在涉及拓扑变化（如切割、剥离）时表现不佳，因为显式连接性改变带来了非线性和不连续性，难以进行梯度优化与鲁棒估计。

Method: 1. 引入基于sigmoid的连续公式，平滑原本离散的组织切割事件，使其可嵌入可微位置基础动力学（PBD）仿真中进行梯度优化；2. 采用Stein变分梯度下降（SVGD）进行基于粒子的概率推断，生成多个拓扑状态假设以应对噪声视觉数据的不确定性；3. 基于该基础开发薄壳组织的自主剥离算法，利用拓扑更新引导闭环切割轨迹控制。

Result: 在仿真和真实电外科环境中评估，相比现有方法，拓扑估计精度和剥离精度均有显著提升。

Conclusion: 该框架通过在复杂结构变化下实现可靠感知与控制，展示了推动软组织手术自动化的潜力。

Abstract: Accurately modeling and tracking the deformation of soft tissue is critical for a wide range of interventional and surgical procedures. However, current methods struggle in scenarios involving topological changes, such as cutting and dissection, due to the inherent non-linearity and discontinuity introduced by explicit changes in connectivity. In this work, we present a novel, fully differentiable framework that enables robust estimation and modeling of topological changes during deformable tracking. Our method introduces a continuous, sigmoid-based formulation to smooth the otherwise discrete event of tissue cutting, making it amenable to gradient-based optimization within a differentiable Position-Based Dynamics (PBD) simulation. To account for uncertainty and improve robustness in the presence of noisy visual data, we incorporate Stein Variational Gradient Descent (SVGD) for particle-based probabilistic inference, generating multiple hypotheses for topological state estimation. Building on this foundation, we develop an autonomous dissection algorithm for thin-shell tissues that leverages topological updates to guide closed-loop cutting trajectory control. We evaluate our approach in both simulated and real-world electrosurgical environments, demonstrating significant improvements in topological estimation accuracy and dissection precision over existing methods. Our results highlight the potential of this framework to advance automation in soft-tissue surgical procedures by enabling reliable perception and control in the presence of complex structural changes.

</details>


### [512] [ReDex: Repairing Sim-to-Real Dexterous Policies by Finger-Level Compliant Interaction](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07525)
*Jinzhou Li,Hadi Tabatabaee,Kelin Yu,Yuyin Sun,Cheng-Hao Kuo,Roberto Martín-Martín,Nima Fazeli,X. Alice Wu,Xianyi Cheng*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: ReDex通过人工局部纠正接触失败并融合触觉力反馈，将仿真训练的多指操作策略适配到真实世界，显著提升接触丰富任务成功率。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 仿真训练的操作策略因接触时序与力调节误差难以迁移到真实世界，但其中仍保留有用的多指协调能力；希望在不依赖触觉仿真与复杂全手遥操作的前提下，用真实交互数据纠正局部接触失败并引入力反馈。

Method: 以仅本体感觉的仿真基策略为起点，在柔性控制下由人类操作员在真实rollout中物理纠正选定手指的接触失败，冻结的基策略继续控制其余手指；收集包含基策略执行、人工纠正动作与指尖力观测的rollout，重建力信息目标，并通过行为克隆训练独立的力条件策略。

Result: 在两个接触丰富的硬件任务上，相比仿真到实际迁移的基策略，ReDex将Object Flipping成功率从14%提升到86%（两个物体），平均Screwdriver Rotation进度从26.0%提升到95.3%（三个物体）。

Conclusion: ReDex可在减少人工纠正负担的同时，从真实交互中学习接触力调节，并为仅本体感觉策略引入力反馈，有效提升真实世界灵巧操作性能。

Abstract: Dexterous manipulation policies trained in simulation often fail to transfer to the real world because of errors in contact timing and force regulation. Yet these policies can retain useful multi-finger coordination for task progression. We propose ReDex, a framework for adapting a simulation-trained base policy to the real world by correcting local contact failures and incorporating tactile feedback. Starting from a proprioception-only base policy, ReDex allows a human operator to physically correct contact failures at selected fingers under compliant control during real-world rollouts, while the frozen base policy continues to control the remaining fingers. These rollouts combine base policy execution, human-corrected finger motion, and fingertip force observations. We reconstruct force-informed targets from these rollouts to train a standalone force-conditioned policy via behavior cloning. This design reduces human correction effort, enables learning of contact regulation from real-world interaction, and introduces force feedback into a proprioception-only policy without tactile simulation or complex full-hand teleoperation. We evaluate ReDex on two challenging, contact-rich dexterous manipulation tasks on real hardware. Compared with sim-to-real transferred base policies, ReDex increases Object Flipping success rate from 14\% to 86\% across two objects and average Screwdriver Rotation progress from 26.0% to 95.3% across three objects.

</details>


### [513] [Task-Space Imitation Guidance for Efficient Reinforcement Learning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07527)
*Salar Asayesh,Hossein Darani,Todd Cao,Evgeny Andriash,Mani Ranjbar*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: TIGER 是一种面向稀疏奖励桌面机器人操作任务的奖励构建与预训练框架，将动作分块模仿策略用作任务空间进度估计器，而非可执行控制器或动作先验。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 稀疏奖励下的机器人操作强化学习样本效率低、早期在线探索易偏离流形并带来安全风险，现有模仿与强化结合方法多把模仿策略当作控制器或动作先验，限制了其利用方式。

Method: 将模仿策略预测的动作分块通过控制器感知的动作到运动映射，转换为短时域末端执行器参考；据此为 RL 智能体提供密集进度奖励，同时保留稀疏环境奖励作为主导目标；预训练阶段利用模仿引导的前瞻信号，对预测能带来任务空间进度的动作放宽保守价值惩罚。

Result: 在仿真与真实机器人实验中，TIGER 相比先前 RL 与 IL-RL 基线提升了早期样本效率、减少了实测安全违规，并在所评估任务上达到或超过最终成功率。

Conclusion: 把模仿策略重新定位为局部任务空间进度估计器，可为稀疏奖励操作任务提供有效的密集塑形与更安全的预训练信号，在不牺牲最终性能的前提下改善早期学习效率与安全性。

Abstract: We introduce Task-Space Imitation Guidance for Efficient Reinforcement Learning (TIGER), a reward-construction and pretraining framework for sparse-reward tabletop robotic manipulation. TIGER treats an action-chunked imitation policy not as an executable controller or action prior, but as a local task-space progress estimator: predicted action chunks are converted, using controller-aware action-to-motion mapping, into short-horizon end-effector references, and the RL agent receives dense progress rewards toward these references while the sparse environment reward remains the dominant objective. During pretraining, TIGER uses imitation-guided look-ahead signals to relax conservative value penalties for actions predicted to make task-space progress, reducing off-manifold exploration during early online RL. Across simulation and real-robot experiments, TIGER improves early sample efficiency and reduces measured safety violations while matching or improving final success rates relative to prior RL and IL-RL baselines on the evaluated tasks.

</details>


### [514] [Seeing the Invisible: Physics-Guided Visual Prompting for Temperature- and Radiation-Aware VLA Navigation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07558)
*Hojoon Son,Fan Zhang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出Physics-Guided Visual Prompting (PG-VP)，一种即插即用的多模态感知模块，通过物理引导的风险评估生成动态虚拟障碍，使冻结的VLA导航模型自然绕开不可见风险（辐射、高温），无需重训练。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 在安全关键设施中，辐射或温度骤升等不可见风险无法被RGB相机检测；传统方法处理每种风险都需新编码器、新数据和模型重训练，成本高昂。因此需要一种可复用已有VLA能力、即插即用的方案。

Method: PG-VP复用冻结VLA模型已具备的"避开可见障碍"能力：给定近距离辐射或热源，先进行物理引导的风险评估以确定规避方向，再在连续帧上叠加一个对应的虚拟障碍（Dynamic Visual Prompting），导航策略便自然绕行该不可见风险。无论风险类型如何都使用相同的虚拟障碍，故传感器增加时视觉提示模式保持不变；未检测到风险时不渲染任何内容，策略行为与无PG-VP时完全一致。

Result: 在OmniNav上，于R2R-CE和RxR-CE的val-unseen划分评估：PG-VP分别引导策略采取预期低风险动作的比例达84.9%和83.2%，导航成功率仅下降6.8和7.9个百分点。在真实机器人上针对实际热源与辐射源测试（无需重训练），最差10%平均轨迹安全性分别提升63.45%（热）与32.59%（辐射）。

Conclusion: PG-VP作为一种即插即用、无需重训练的多模态感知模块，能有效让VLA导航模型规避不可见的辐射与热风险，且对传感器类型不敏感，为安全关键环境下的视觉-语言导航提供了低成本、可扩展的解决方案。

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) models have become a major paradigm for Vision-and-Language Navigation (VLN). However, in safety-critical facilities, invisible risks such as radiation or temperature spikes cannot be detected by an RGB camera, and handling each risk is expensive, requiring a new encoder, new data, and model retraining. We propose Physics-Guided Visual Prompting (PG-VP), a plug-and-play multimodal perception module that instead reuses what a frozen VLA model already does well: avoiding visible obstacles. Given a proximal radiation or thermal source, PG-VP performs a physics-guided risk assessment to determine the avoidance direction and overlays a corresponding virtual obstacle that moves across consecutive frames (Dynamic Visual Prompting). The navigation policy then naturally detours around this invisible hazard. The identical virtual obstacle is used regardless of hazard type, so the visual prompting pattern remains fixed as sensors are added. When no hazard is detected, nothing is rendered, and the policy behaves exactly as it would without PG-VP. We evaluate PG-VP on OmniNav using the val-unseen splits of R2R-CE and RxR-CE, where it guides the policy toward intended low-risk actions in 84.9% and 83.2% of cases, at a cost of 6.8 and 7.9 percentage points in navigation success rate. We further test it with distinct scenarios on a real robot in the presence of actual thermal and radiation sources, all without any retraining. The real test shows that PG-VP effectively avoids these invisible hazards, improving worst-10% average trajectory safety by 63.45% and 32.59% against thermal and radiation sources, respectively.

</details>


### [515] [OpenSplatGraph: From Dense Semantic Maps to Structured Scene Graphs for Open-Vocabulary Robot Perception](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07569)
*Binh Long Nguyen,Kien Nguyen,Clinton Fookes,Peyman Moghadam*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: OpenSplatGraph：从在线高斯开放词汇语义地图直接构建持久3D场景图的统一框架，结合可靠性感知语义场实现置信度感知的对象提取与增量更新，兼顾语言引导定位与结构化关系推理。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 稠密3D语义建图对复杂环境下的机器人感知至关重要。基于3D高斯泼溅的建图虽能提供高保真几何与高效开放词汇感知，但语义以非结构化特征场表示，限制对象级推理；而3D场景图虽显式建模对象及关系，却多由稀疏几何构建，未能充分利用稠密语义地图。

Method: 提出OpenSplatGraph统一框架：在稠密开放词汇高斯语义地图上增加可靠性感知语义场，维护轻量观测统计以支持置信度感知、查询条件的对象提取；将提取的对象实例与持久图节点关联，随观测与查询增量更新对象属性与关系，紧耦合稠密语义建图与持久对象中心表示。

Result: 在标准3D场景理解基准与真实机器人实验中，OpenSplatGraph在在线开放词汇感知及下游机器人任务上取得有竞争力的性能。

Conclusion: 将稠密语义建图与持久对象中心表示紧耦合，可同时支持语言引导的对象定位与结构化关系推理，并保持高斯建图的几何保真度。

Abstract: Dense 3D mapping with semantic understanding is essential for robotic perception in complex environments. Recent 3D Gaussian Splatting-based mapping approaches enable high-fidelity geometry and efficient open-vocabulary perception, but typically represent semantics as unstructured feature fields that limit object-centric reasoning. In contrast, 3D scene graphs explicitly model objects and their relationships for structured reasoning, but are commonly constructed from sparse geometric representations that do not fully exploit dense semantic maps. In this work, we present OpenSplatGraph, a unified framework that constructs persistent 3D scene graphs directly from an online Gaussian-based open-vocabulary semantic map. The proposed framework augments the dense semantic map with a reliability-aware semantic field that maintains lightweight observation statistics for confidence-aware, query-conditioned object extraction. Extracted object instances are associated with persistent graph nodes, allowing object attributes and relationships to be incrementally updated across observations and queries. By tightly coupling dense semantic mapping with persistent object-centric representations, our framework supports both language-guided object grounding and structured relational reasoning while preserving the geometric fidelity of Gaussian-based mapping. Comprehensive evaluations on standard 3D scene understanding benchmarks and real-world robotic experiments demonstrate that OpenSplatGraph achieves competitive performance for online open-vocabulary perception and downstream robotic tasks. Project page: https://csiro-robotics.github.io/OpenSplatGraph.

</details>


### [516] [BiGym 2.0: Benchmarking Learned and Agent-Developed Policies for Humanoid Household Manipulation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07594)
*Zexi Zhang,Zecheng Zhu,Zidong Chen,Zulkhuu Tuya,Stephen James*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出 BiGym 2.0：面向 Unitree G1 人形机器人的 20 项家务操作基准，配备统一全身控制器与 60 条 VR 人类演示/任务，并系统比较 VLA 微调、模仿学习、演示驱动强化学习与冷启动编码智能体。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人形家务操作需手臂动作与身体平衡、迈步、变姿协同进行。现有基准多缺乏统一全身控制、原生人类演示数据，以及在同一交互预算下对多种学习范式的公平比较，因此需要新的评测套件。

Method: 基于 BiGym 适配 Unitree G1，覆盖 20 项家务任务，采用统一全身控制器用于演示采集与评测；每任务提供 60 条原生 VR 人类演示，含同步多相机视图与全身执行记录；在相同在线强化学习交互预算下，基准测试 VLA 微调、模仿学习、演示驱动强化学习与冷启动编码智能体，所有方法共享机载视图、本体感觉与全身控制器。

Result: 在相同设定下，视觉-语言-动作（VLA）微调取得最高的九任务均值；智能体开发的程序在该均值上超过所有演示驱动强化学习基线，并在双臂抓取上领先。跨工作区堆叠仍未解决，π_{0.5} 在抓取盒子任务上表现偏低；多物体搬运对模仿学习、演示驱动强化学习与编码智能体均较困难。

Conclusion: BiGym 2.0 为人形全身家务操作提供了统一、可复现的评测平台，表明 VLA 微调与编码智能体是当前较有前景的路线，同时揭示了跨工作区堆叠、π_{0.5} 抓盒与多物体搬运等开放难题。全部环境、人类演示与评测轨迹已开源。

Abstract: Humanoid household manipulation requires the arms to act while the body balances, steps and changes posture. We present BiGym 2.0, an adaptation of BiGym for the Unitree G1 across 20 household tasks using a unified whole-body controller for demonstration and evaluation. The suite provides 60 native human virtual-reality demonstrations per task with synchronised multi-camera views and full-body execution records. We benchmark vision-language-action fine-tuning, imitation learning, demo-driven reinforcement learning, and cold-start coding agents given the interaction budget of online reinforcement learning. With the same onboard views, proprioception and whole-body controller for every method, vision-language-action fine-tuning has the highest nine-task mean, and agent-developed programs outperform every demo-driven reinforcement learning baseline on this mean and lead on bimanual reaching. Cross-workspace stacking remains open, $π_{0.5}$ stays low on pick-box, and multi-object transport is hard for imitation learning, demo-driven reinforcement learning and coding agents. All environments, human demonstrations, and evaluation traces are open-sourced at https://github.com/swirl-uk/BiGym2.

</details>


### [517] [The Robot Is Not Its Description: GaugeBench for Representation Robustness in Morphology-Aware Policies](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07597)
*Rahath Malladi,Arshia Sangwan,Rajesh K. Gupta,Tauhidur Rahman*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该论文提出GaugeBench，通过改写机器人描述使物理等效但约定不同，发现策略性能会因“描述变化”而崩溃，说明跨本体评估需同时测试机制与表示鲁棒性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人描述不仅指定物理机制，还编码关节轴方向、关节角零位、链接与关节的命名和顺序等任意约定。现有跨本体评估通常改变机器人但固定这些约定，因此无法回答：机器人不变、描述变化时行为能否保持。论文要隔离并研究这一被忽视的问题。

Method: 提出GaugeBench，在物理等效约定下重写固定机制，验证物理与策略接口保持后，用同一策略权重评估。分析轴反转、关节角零位变化、重排序，以及关节状态/力矩坐标与描述派生特征的影响；并在ModuMorph和PyBullet框架中复现，测试精确双描述传输和跨等效轴约定训练。

Result: 三个MetaMorph策略在80个熟悉机器人上得分4030.6，但等效重描述后仅51.6，而98个真正留出机器人得分1489.6。轴反转单独即可复现崩溃，关节角零位变化几乎无害，重排序影响居中；仅改变关节状态与力矩坐标足以导致失败，仅改变描述派生特征不会。相同现象出现在ModuMorph与无关PyBullet框架中。精确双描述传输可恢复原控制器；跨等效轴约定训练将轴反转下保留回报从3.6%提升至80.6%。

Conclusion: 机器人描述变化可能比更换机器人更具破坏性。应区分机制鲁棒性与表示鲁棒性，跨本体评估必须同时测试两者。

Abstract: A robot description does more than specify a physical mechanism: it also encodes arbitrary conventions, such as joint-axis direction, joint-angle zero, and the order and names of links and joints. Morphology-aware policies consume interfaces built from these descriptions, yet cross-embodiment evaluation typically changes the robot while keeping those conventions fixed. This leaves a simple question unanswered: does behavior survive when the robot stays fixed but its description changes? GaugeBench isolates this case by rewriting a fixed mechanism under physically equivalent conventions, verifying that its physics and policy interface are preserved, and then evaluating the same policy weights. The result is stark: three MetaMorph policies score 4030.6 on 80 familiar robots, but only 51.6 when those same robots are equivalently re-described, while 98 genuinely held-out robots score 1489.6. A new description can therefore be more damaging than a new robot. Tracing the failure reveals that axis reversal alone reproduces the collapse, joint-angle zero changes are nearly harmless, and reordering lies between them; moreover, changing joint-state and torque coordinates alone is sufficient to cause the failure, while changing description-derived features alone is not. The same phenomenon appears in ModuMorph and an unrelated PyBullet framework. Yet it is not irreversible: exact two-description transport restores the original controller, and training across equivalent axis conventions raises retained return under axis reversal from 3.6% to 80.6%. Together, these results separate mechanism robustness from representation robustness and show that cross-embodiment evaluation should test both.

</details>


### [518] [Modeling Latent Disturbances for Robust Decision-Making in World Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07599)
*Junwon Seo,Andrea Bajcsy*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文研究在世界模型隐空间中的鲁棒决策，通过将隐扰动建模为对学习隐动力学的扰动，并利用保形预测校准不确定性集，联合优化鲁棒动作与最坏情况隐扰动，从而在仿真和Franka机械臂上实现鲁棒策略引导。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 鲁棒优化通常需要明确给定的动力学和物理扰动，但世界模型的状态空间和动力学是从高维观测中学习得到的，难以定义能够忠实反映系统不确定性的隐空间扰动，这是将鲁棒优化应用于WM隐空间的核心挑战。

Method: 将隐空间扰动建模为对学习隐动力学的扰动，诱导悲观但合理的转移；通过结合动力学感知相似度度量与分布外检测构建合理隐动力学集合；用保形预测校准隐动力学的不确定性集，避免过度悲观；再通过博弈论优化联合优化鲁棒动作与最坏情况隐扰动，并应用于隐安全过滤和生成式控制策略的采样-验证两种策略引导范式。

Result: 仿真实验表明隐扰动能够直接在世界模型隐空间中实现鲁棒决策；Franka机械臂硬件实验显示，建模隐扰动可实现鲁棒策略引导，安全过滤失败率降低70%，基于采样的策略引导失败率降低54%。

Conclusion: 在WM隐空间中建模隐扰动并结合保形预测校准，可实现有效且不过度悲观的鲁棒决策与策略引导，显著减少真实机器人任务中的失败。

Abstract: In this paper, we study robust decision-making in the latent space of world models (WMs). Robust optimization is a mathematical framework where, given explicitly specified dynamics and physically meaningful disturbances, a robot can select actions that remain effective even under worst-case disturbances. However, applying this principle to the learned latent space of WMs introduces a fundamental challenge: because WMs have fully learned state spaces and dynamics inferred from high-dimensional observations, it is unclear how to define latent-space disturbances that faithfully represent uncertainty in the underlying system. Our key idea is to model a latent-space disturbance as a perturbation to the learned latent dynamics that induces pessimistic but plausible transitions. Specifically, we construct a set of plausible latent dynamics by combining a dynamics-aware similarity metric that captures plausible transitions with out-of-distribution detection that excludes implausible latent states. We calibrate this uncertainty set over latent dynamics using conformal prediction, ensuring that WM imaginations induced by the latent disturbance remain plausible without becoming overly pessimistic. We then jointly optimize robust robot actions and the worst-case latent disturbances through game-theoretic optimization. We leverage this latent-space robust optimization to robustify policy steering, considering two paradigms: latent safety filtering and sample-and-verify steering of a generative control policy. Our controlled simulation experiments show that our latent disturbance enables robust decision-making directly in WM latent spaces, and hardware experiments with a Franka manipulator show that modeling latent disturbances enables robust policy steering, reducing failures by 70% in safety filtering and 54% in sampling-based policy steering. Project website: https://junwon.me/LatentDisturbance/.

</details>


### [519] [Learning Grasp Targeting from Point Clouds for Log Pile Clearing on a Hydraulic Crane](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07613)
*George Sideris,Lucas Bessai,Heshan Fernando,Elie Ayoub,Nicolas Lemieux,Inna Sharf*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该论文研究在贮木场中利用从无分割点云学习到的抓取策略，控制车载液压林业起重机抓取并搬运成堆原木，通过仿真训练BC、RL及BC→RL策略并与几何启发式方法进行实地对比。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 贮木场中原木密集堆叠、相互接触，每次抓取都会改变下一次可抓取的木堆形态；从无分割点云中决定抓斗的位置与朝向十分困难，而现有方法多依赖人工设计的几何启发式规则，性能有限。

Method: 学习策略从无分割点云中选取抓取点并预测该处的抓取深度与抓斗朝向；同一网络支持行为克隆（BC）、强化学习（RL）及BC→RL微调。BC从成功的堆顶示范中学习，RL则从零训练或对克隆策略进行微调。在仿真中训练后原样部署到拖车式液压林业起重机上，并开展12次实地试验，对比几何启发式、RL从零训练、BC和BC→RL在完整"抓取—运输—放置"循环中的表现。点云未经过滤波，仍包含储木架的横梁和立柱。

Result: 仿真中BC在100堆每堆200根原木的测试中成功清理98堆，BC→RL进一步提升了装载稳定性。实地试验中，BC和BC→RL分别搬运了总库存的93.8%和88.9%，优于启发式的80.4%；BC→RL在83.6%的循环中成功放置原木，启发式为79.6%，BC为65.7%；但其仿真中的稳定性优势未能在起重机测试平台上复现。

Conclusion: 完全在仿真中训练、未经修改即部署到真实起重机上的学习策略，在观测含储木架横梁与立柱的未滤波点云时，仍能清理比人工筛选的启发式方法更多的原木，表明仿真到现实的迁移对林业抓取任务具有可行性。

Abstract: In mill yards, log loaders clear dense piles by a sequence of bundle grasps: hundreds of logs rest in contact, and each removal changes the pile available to the next grasp. A learned policy chooses where to place and orient the grapple from unsegmented point clouds and runs on a trailer-mounted hydraulic forestry crane. The policy classifies at which observed point to grasp and predicts depth and grapple orientation there. The same network outputs support behavior cloning (BC), reinforcement learning (RL), and deployment. BC learns from successful top-of-pile demonstrations; RL explores for improvements by fine-tuning the cloned policy (BC$\to$RL) or by training from scratch. In simulation, BC clears 98 of 100 piles of 200 logs, while BC$\to$RL improves load stability. Twelve field trials compare a geometric heuristic, RL from scratch, BC, and BC$\to$RL through complete grasp-transport-deposit cycles. BC and BC$\to$RL deposit 93.8% and 88.9% of pooled inventory, against 80.4% for the heuristic. BC$\to$RL deposits logs on 83.6% of its cycles, against 79.6% for the heuristic and 65.7% for BC, while its simulated stability gain does not carry over to the crane testbed. Trained entirely in simulation and run unchanged on the crane, the learned policies clear more than the hand-filtered heuristic while observing unfiltered clouds that still contain the storage rack's rails and poles.

</details>


### [520] [Nine Trials to Recover: A Reproducible Benchmark for Repertoire-Free Soft-Robot Damage Adaptation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07616)
*Siyuan Zhang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出一个无预设库（repertoire-free）的软体机器人损伤恢复基准，采用九次在线试验协议，并给出基于高斯过程期望改进（GP-EI）的参考控制器，在两个互斥的75体队列上系统评估其相对随机搜索、Sobol、CEM与CMA-ES等基线方法的优势。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 软体机器人损伤恢复研究缺乏统一、可复现的评测标准，尤其是缺少能隔离方法开发与评估、避免依赖预设行为库的基准协议，导致不同自适应方法之间的增益难以公平比较，也无法衡量"学习到的损伤先验"的真实附加值。

Method: 设计无预设库的损伤恢复基准协议：在每种形态内配对损伤掩码，保留测量得到的标称回退策略，并将方法开发与新机体评估分离。以GP-EI作为参考控制器，使用三次初始化探测和六次基于反馈选择的rollout来调整执行器相位；在等预算条件下与随机搜索、Sobol、CEM、CMA-ES及TuRBO式局部GP对比；并通过确认后的固定控制器重放、严格"无新增需求"部署门以及冻结开发压力测试（物理移除10%占用体素）进行验证。

Result: 在两个互斥的75体队列中，GP-EI在等预算下优于随机搜索、Sobol、CEM和CMA-ES；在确认集上，69/75个机体的最差掩码增益得到改善，平均最差掩码奖励高出这四个基线0.235-0.310。TuRBO式局部GP是最接近的对比方法，其配对置信区间包含零。确认后固定控制器重放显示平均恢复5.06个体素宽度，同时最差掩码p99几何边缘应变增加0.0031；严格部署门保留48.7%的平均增益。在冻结压力测试中GP-EI改善71/75个机体，平均最差掩码增益比官方BoTorch TuRBO高0.356。

Conclusion: 可重放的控制器、机体级推理与冻结队列评估共同构成一个参考框架，可用于衡量学习到的损伤先验及未来自适应方法的附加价值，并为软体机器人损伤恢复研究提供可复现、可比较的评测标准。

Abstract: We present a repertoire-free benchmark for soft-robot damage recovery under nine online trials. The protocol pairs damage masks within each morphology, retains a measured nominal fallback, and separates method development from evaluation on new bodies. A Gaussian-process expected-improvement (GP-EI) reference controller adapts actuator phases using three initialization probes and six feedback-selected rollouts. Across two disjoint 75-body cohorts, it outperforms random search, Sobol, CEM, and CMA-ES under equal budgets. GP-EI improves the worst-mask gain on 69/75 confirmation bodies and exceeds these four baselines by 0.235-0.310 mean worst-mask reward. A TuRBO-style local GP is the closest comparator; the paired confidence interval includes zero. Post-confirmation fixed-controller replay finds 5.06 voxel widths of mean recovery together with a 0.0031 increase in worst-mask p99 geometric edge strain; a strict no-added-demand deployment gate retains 48.7% of mean gain. In a frozen development stress test that physically removes 10% of occupied voxels, GP-EI improves 71/75 bodies and exceeds official BoTorch TuRBO by 0.356 mean worst-mask gain. Together, the replayable controllers, body-level inference, and frozen-cohort evaluation provide a reference for measuring the added value of learned damage priors and future adaptation methods.

</details>


### [521] [TacZero: Training-Free Peg Insertion Using a General-Purpose Vision-Language Model with Tactile Feedback](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07621)
*Kazutoshi Tanaka*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: TacZero 利用预训练的通用视觉语言模型（VLM），结合视觉与触觉观测直接选择机器人动作，无需额外的触觉训练或任务特定规则，在真实圆柱插销任务中取得成功。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 接触丰富的操作任务中，机器人需推断物体间的接触及其导致的运动，进而选择动作。现有方法依赖专门设计的估计模型、触觉反馈控制律或针对触觉数据训练的学习模型，缺乏通用性且需任务特定训练。

Method: 提出 TacZero，将相机图像、机器人状态以及以数值或叠加在图像上的向量形式表示的三轴触觉响应输入给预训练的通用 VLM，由 VLM 根据观测和交互历史生成目标末端执行器位置及夹爪开合指令，再交由底层控制器执行，全程无需额外触觉或操作训练，也无需任务特定规则。

Result: 在真实世界的圆柱插销实验中，提供数值触觉输入时 TacZero 在 20 次试验中成功 15 次，而无触觉输入时为 10 次（20 次）。

Conclusion: 该研究为使用通用 VLM 进行接触丰富操作提供了具体的起点，并指出了该方向面临的挑战。

Abstract: Robots that autonomously determine their actions from language instructions and sensory observations could perform new contact-rich manipulation tasks without task-specific training or hand-designed rules. To perform these tasks, robots must infer how objects contact one another and move as a result, then select actions. For contact inference and action selection, prior approaches involve designing estimation models and tactile feedback control laws, or learning models for object-motion estimation, action-outcome prediction, and action selection from tactile data. Instead, we propose TacZero, which uses a pretrained general-purpose vision-language model (VLM) to interpret visual and tactile observations and select robot actions without additional tactile or manipulation training or task-specific rules for contact interpretation or action selection. TacZero provides the VLM with camera images, robot state, and three-axis tactile responses represented as numerical values or vectors overlaid on the images. From these observations and interaction history, the VLM generates commands specifying target end-effector positions and gripper opening or closing, which a low-level controller executes. In real-world cylindrical-peg insertion experiments, TacZero succeeded in 15 of 20 trials with numerical tactile input, compared with 10 of 20 without tactile input. This study provides a concrete starting point for further research on contact-rich manipulation using general-purpose VLMs and highlights challenges in pursuing this direction.

</details>


### [522] [Beyond Task Reward: A Controller-Restriction Protocol for Evaluating Embodiment-Dependent Competence](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07629)
*Siyuan Zhang*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 论文提出"受限控制能力"（restricted-control competence）作为共设计形态的可报告属性：在显式声明的低复杂度控制器族下测量形态保留的任务能力，发现其与任务奖励仅有部分相关，可靠但依赖控制器族定义。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 传统共设计方法用完全优化后的任务奖励一个数值来评判形态，但该数值无法区分那些对控制器依赖程度差异极大的形态。因此需要一个能刻画形态自身能力、而非依赖控制器优化程度的度量。

Method: 将形态评估限定在显式声明的低复杂度控制器族、环境、任务与搜索预算下，记录其保留的任务能力。在三个 EvoGym 运动任务上测试，进行运行分组交叉验证、优化器重启可靠性分析、不同控制器族（按执行器索引相位 vs 按位置排序）的对比，并将其用作第二搜索目标或奖励搜索后的选择准则。

Result: 任务奖励仅解释该度量方差的 39%、33% 和 10%；几何描述符在运行分组交叉验证下无法预测该度量。测量在优化器重启间可靠（ICC(2,k)=0.956–0.986），但依赖声明族：换用相位方式后同一批形态 Spearman 相关仅 0.50–0.63 且奖励匹配对序反转。作为第二目标，5 次配对运行中 3 次在匹配奖励下提升能力，未达预注册的 4 次门槛；作为奖励搜索后的选择准则，在 8 次可选择的运行中全部选出不同形态，奖励代价至多 0.10，且 6/8 次在留出族下得分更高。

Conclusion: 受限控制能力是共设计形态的一个可报告属性，但只能在定义它的控制器族语境下解释。

Abstract: Co-design methods optimize a robot's body and controller jointly and judge the result by one number, the task reward of the fully optimized pair. That number cannot separate morphologies whose competence depends on the controller to very different degrees. We evaluate a morphology by restricting its controller instead, recording the task competence it retains under an explicitly declared, low-complexity controller family, environment, task and search budget. On three EvoGym locomotion tasks, task reward explains only $39\%$, $33\%$ and $10\%$ of the variance in this quantity, and geometric descriptors do not predict it under run-grouped cross-validation. The measurement is reliable across optimizer restarts (ICC$(2,k) = 0.956$--$0.986$) but depends on the declared family: phasing the drive by actuator index instead of position ranks the same morphologies at Spearman $0.50$--$0.63$ and reverses reward-matched pairs. As a second search objective the axis improved competence at matched task reward in $3$ of $5$ paired runs, short of a pre-registered bar of $4$. Used after an ordinary reward-only search instead, to choose within its top task-reward band, it selected a different body in all $8$ runs offering a choice, at a cost of at most $0.10$ reward units, and in $6$ of $8$ that body also scored higher under a held-out family. Restricted-control competence is therefore a reportable property of a co-designed morphology, interpretable only with the controller family that defines it.

</details>


### [523] [OntoPlan: An Ontology-Grounded Scene Representation and Agentic Framework for Scalable Robot Task Planning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07649)
*Hyeongwoo Nam,Woongje Cho,Juwon Kim,Jongeun Choi*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出本体驱动的场景表示与OntoPlan智能体框架，实现大环境中长时程机器人任务规划，成功率和token效率显著优于基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于LLM的机器人任务规划在开放式指令跟随上有前景，但在大环境长时程任务中性能下降。文本传递空间信息难以捕捉空间上下文，token成本随环境规模增长；直接用LLM生成动作序列难以满足世界状态与动作前置条件。

Method: 提出本体驱动的场景表示，将对象、空间、关系、状态对齐到共享符号词汇以支持空间推理与任务规划；并提出OntoPlan智能体框架，用于解析指令、选择性检索任务相关信息、形式化目标与约束并生成可执行计划。

Result: 在5个室内环境、3种场景尺度的150个通用任务上，OntoPlan平均任务成功率0.89，最强基线仅0.27；每任务平均消耗18.1k token，约为最高效基线的1/5.6。随场景尺度增大优势保持，而先前方法成功率下降更明显且token成本更高。

Conclusion: OntoPlan能对模糊或不可行指令恰当响应，通过追问或报告信息不足而非执行无效计划；代码已开源。

Abstract: Large language model (LLM)-based robot task planning is promising for open-ended instruction following, but degrades on long-horizon tasks in large environments. When spatial information is conveyed to the LLM through text, the model can fail to capture spatial context, and token cost grows with environment size. Generating action sequences directly with an LLM also makes it difficult to satisfy the current world state and action preconditions. We address this with an ontology-grounded scene representation that aligns objects, spaces, relations, and states in a shared symbolic vocabulary for spatial reasoning and task planning, and with OntoPlan, an agentic framework that interprets instructions, selectively retrieves task-relevant information, formalizes goals and constraints, and produces executable plans. Across 150 general tasks spanning five indoor environments and three scene scales, OntoPlan achieves 0.89 average task success, compared with 0.27 for the strongest baseline, while using 18.1k total tokens per task on average, about 5.6$\times$ fewer than the most efficient baseline. These advantages persist as scene scale increases, whereas prior methods degrade more sharply in success and remain far more costly in tokens. OntoPlan also responds appropriately to ambiguous or infeasible instructions by asking follow-up questions or reporting insufficient information rather than committing to invalid plans. Code available at https://github.com/namhyeongwoo/OntoPlan.

</details>


### [524] [Silicon Language: A Robot-Native Knowledge Exchange Framework for Heterogeneous Robots](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07650)
*Yi Liu,Xianglin Meng,Chang Chen,Jingjing Fan*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出"Silicon Language"机器人原生知识交换框架，将机器人视为自身能力演化的主体，通过知识包编码、发布、检索、翻译与本地试用审查实现跨异构机器人的能力复用，并在矿区仿真实验室等场景进行30天概念验证部署。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 跨异构机器人复用能力目前仍需大量人工适配与验证：迁移一项技能往往意味着重新设计接口、重新调参并重新验证安全性。作者希望降低这一成本，让机器人成为自身能力演化的主动参与者。

Method: 框架包含三个基础设施层（边缘智能体、Silicon Transfer Protocol、知识中枢）以及受人类学术体系启发的"能力栈"。需要能力的机器人将自身经验编码为知识包，进行发布与检索同伴知识包，并针对自身传感器与执行器进行翻译；接收端通过独立的本地试用进行可用性评估，决定外部知识包是否有用，并采用渐进式融合与自动回滚来降低负迁移风险。

Result: 在榆林某地上模拟矿井实验室完成30天概念验证部署，随后在室外沙石路与室内工厂地面开展试验。两台异构机器人通过操作员辅助的文件拷贝（经Silicon Language翻译层中介）跨本体编码与翻译了三项能力；源端"扬尘锁定跟随"行为的试验记录于Taurus平台。项目记录显示每项能力的适配时间从数天降至数小时，但作者将其作为描述性部署记录而非受控测量。

Conclusion: 该部署为跨本体知识交换提供了初步证据；集群级自主演化以及有无知识包的受控对比实验仍属未来工作。

Abstract: Reusing a capability across heterogeneous robots still requires substantial human adaptation and verification: transferring a skill often means re-engineering interfaces, retuning parameters, and re-validating safety. We introduce Silicon Language, a robot-native knowledge exchange framework that treats the robot as the active subject of its own capability evolution. In this framework, a robot that wants a capability encodes its own experience into knowledge packets, publishes them, retrieves peer packets, translates them for its own sensors and actuators, and reviews them through independent local trial. A receiver-side usability evaluation procedure lets each robot decide for itself whether an external packet is useful, and progressive blending with automatic rollback is designed to reduce the risk of negative transfer when adopting it. The system combines three infrastructure layers (edge agent, Silicon Transfer Protocol (STP), and knowledge hub) with a capability stack inspired by the human scholarly system. We report a 30-day proof-of-concept deployment at an above-ground simulated-mine laboratory in Yulin, with following trials on an outdoor sand road and an indoor factory floor. Two heterogeneous robots encoded and translated three capabilities across embodiments through operator-assisted file copies mediated by the Silicon Language translation layer; source-side trials of the dust-locked following behavior were recorded on Taurus. Project records indicate that per-capability adaptation time dropped from days to hours; we present these figures as descriptive deployment records rather than controlled measurements. The deployment provides initial evidence for cross-embodiment knowledge exchange; fleet-level autonomous evolution and controlled with/without-packet comparisons remain future work.

</details>


### [525] [SMART: Zero-Shot Sim-to-Real Articulated Object Manipulation via Large-Scale Synthetic Pretraining](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07652)
*Jicong Ao,Shuhan Jiang,Yuling Zhong,Yanwen Liu,Yuhan Gao,Jiangyuan Zhao,Yang Zhang,Shiqiang Zhu,Chenjia Bai,Xuelong Li*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出SMART系统，通过仿真合成大规模铰接物体操作演示数据，提升VLA模型的零样本仿真到现实迁移能力。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 铰接物体交互对具身智能至关重要，但真实世界演示数据采集困难（涉及精确接触与约束跟随运动）。现有仿真合成数据覆盖的铰接物体类别有限，且通用合成流程缺乏部件级语义和铰接约束的显式设计，难以实现可扩展的高质量演示合成。

Method: 提出SMART系统，核心是SMART-Sim仿真平台，具备铰接感知设计，支持有效任务生成与高效演示采集；在其基础上引入智能体任务生成，并设计可扩展的分布式合成系统，合成SMART-Data数据集（超100万条演示，涵盖44种原子任务、5种机器人设置、2507个铰接物体）。

Result: 在SMART-Data上预训练的VLA模型在仿真基准上表现有竞争力，并实现零样本仿真到现实迁移，在真实铰接物体操作任务中展现出可扩展性能。

Conclusion: 合成演示可为接触丰富的铰接物体操作提供有效且可扩展的监督，提升VLA模型性能。

Abstract: The ability to interact with articulated objects is essential for embodied intelligent systems, but collecting large-scale real-world demonstrations for these interactions remains challenging due to the precise contact and constraint-following motions involved. Although simulation provides a promising alternative, existing synthetic data efforts cover limited articulated-object categories, while general-purpose synthesis pipelines lack explicit designs for part-level semantics and articulation constraints, hindering agentic task generation and scalable synthesis of high-quality articulated-manipulation demonstrations. To bridge this gap, we introduce SMART, a scalable system leveraging large-scale Synthesized Manipulation demonstrations for ARTiculated-object manipulation. At its core, we develop SMART-Sim, a simulation platform with articulation-aware design that enables effective task generation and efficient demonstration collection. Building on SMART-Sim, we apply agentic task generation and design a scalable distributed synthesis system, using them to synthesize SMART-Data, comprising over 1M demonstrations across 44 atomic task types, 5 robot setups, and 2,507 articulated objects. The vision-language-action (VLA) model pretrained on SMART-Data shows competitive performance on simulation benchmarks and achieves zero-shot sim-to-real transfer and scalable performance in real-world articulated-object manipulation tasks. This highlights the potential of synthetic demonstrations in providing effective and scalable supervision for improving VLA model performance in contact-rich articulated-object manipulation.

</details>


### [526] [EigenDEXplore: Structured Exploration for Dexterous Manipulation with Human Priors](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07681)
*Harsh Gupta,Tyler Ga Wei Lum,Changhao Wang,Chuer Pan,C. Karen Liu,Jeannette Bohg,Shuran Song*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该论文提出EigenDEXplore，通过沿人类手部数据导出的特征向量添加扰动来诱导相关探索，而不改变动作空间，在多种灵巧操作任务中优于基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 灵巧操作是高维优化难题，需要多关节协调运动。强化学习和采样轨迹优化中，探索常依赖独立的机器人关节扰动，难以发现协调行为。现有工作用人类手部数据学习低维协调关节动作空间来降低搜索维度，但限制了通用操作所需的表达能力；也有方法将学习动作空间与关节空间结合以恢复表达能力，却增加了维度并引入冗余。

Method: 作者系统研究了动作维度、探索策略和人类数据来源在不同操作设置下的影响。发现人类运动先验在用于"结构化探索"而非"改变动作表示"时最有效。据此提出EigenDEXplore：在独立的关节空间噪声上，叠加沿人类数据导出的特征向量方向的扰动，从而在不改变动作空间的前提下诱导相关探索。

Result: 在多种灵巧手上，EigenDEXplore在抓取、手内重定向和接触丰富的操作任务中，一致优于关节空间和学习动作空间基线。这些提升覆盖无结构化和参考引导的RL、轨迹优化以及sim-to-real部署，且在奖励塑形和课程设计较少的设置中增益最大。

Conclusion: 人类运动先验的最佳用途是结构化探索而非改变动作表示；通过沿人类特征向量方向添加相关扰动，可在不增加维度的情况下显著提升灵巧操作的探索效率和最终性能。

Abstract: Dexterous manipulation poses a challenging high-dimensional optimization problem, as useful behaviors require coordinated motion across many hand joints. In reinforcement learning (RL) and sampling-based trajectory optimization, exploration commonly relies on independent robot joint perturbations, making coordinated behaviors difficult to discover. Prior work reduces this search space for grasp learning using low-dimensional spaces of coordinated joint motions learned from human hand data, but this restricts the expressivity required for general manipulation. Some combine learned and joint-space actions to restore expressivity, but this increases dimensionality and introduces redundancy. We study these effects across diverse manipulation settings, varying action dimensionality, exploration strategy, and the source of human data. Our experiments suggest that human-motion priors are most effective when used to structure exploration rather than change the action representation. Motivated by this finding, we propose EigenDEXplore, which induces correlated exploration by adding perturbations along human-derived eigenvectors to independent joint-space noise, leaving the action space unchanged. Across multiple dexterous hands, EigenDEXplore consistently outperforms joint-space and learned action-space baselines in grasping, in-hand reorientation, and contact-rich manipulation. These gains span unstructured and reference-guided RL, trajectory optimization, and sim-to-real deployment, and are largest in settings with less reward shaping and curriculum design.

</details>


### [527] [ExoBridge: Learning a Bare Hand to Hand-Worn Exoskeleton Mapping through Human Limb Coupling](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07692)
*Ruitong Tian,Xianyao Li,Noah B. Wilson,Fang Xu,Eric Jing Du*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出ExoBridge框架，利用人类双侧肢体耦合，从裸手视频预测外骨骼的运动与触觉状态，实现机器人操作的监督学习。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 人类视频是灵巧机器人学习的可扩展经验来源，但在保留裸手交互的同时获取运动与触觉监督十分困难。

Method: 采集时一只手保持裸手提供视觉观测，另一只手佩戴外骨骼提供同步运动与触觉测量；用配对演示训练时序视觉模型，从裸手视频预测指尖接触、连续触觉强度与相对编码器运动；外骨骼定义的中间状态空间通过标定与灵巧机械手相连。

Result: 在四个操作任务、1215条演示（含留出采集会话）上评估，接触检测池化AUROC为0.916，触觉强度Pearson相关为0.790；模型还能从裸手视频预测外骨骼构型的相对变化。

Conclusion: 人类肢体耦合可将外骨骼测量转化为裸手视频的监督信号，建立起从人类视觉演示到面向机器人的操作接口的学习桥梁。

Abstract: Human video offers a scalable source of experience for dexterous robot learning, but obtaining motion and tactile supervision while preserving bare hand interaction remains challenging. We present ExoBridge, a framework that leverages human limb coupling to learn a bridging function from bare hand video to the motion and tactile state of a sensorized exoskeleton. Our central idea is to use coordinated bimanual behavior to connect an uninstrumented visual source with a measured manipulation interface. During collection, one hand remains bare and provides visual observations, while the opposite hand wears the exoskeleton and supplies synchronized motion and tactile measurements. These paired demonstrations train a temporal visual model to predict fingertip contact, continuous tactile intensity, and relative encoder motion from bare hand video alone. The exoskeleton defines an intermediate state space whose motion coordinates are linked to a dexterous robot hand through existing calibration. Evaluation on 1,215 demonstrations across four manipulation tasks uses held out collection sessions and yields a pooled any contact AUROC of 0.916 and a Pearson correlation of 0.790 for tactile intensity. The learned bridge also predicts relative changes in exoskeleton configuration from bare hand video. These results demonstrate that human limb coupling can turn exoskeleton measurements into supervision for bare hand video, establishing a learned bridge between human visual demonstrations and a robot oriented manipulation interface.

</details>


### [528] [ESP: Energy-Score Policy for One-Step Multimodal Action Generation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07696)
*Lilika Makabe,Heecheol Kim,Yasuyuki Matsushita*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: ESP（Energy-Score Policy）是一种无需教师模型的单步生成式动作策略：用能量分数替代均方误差来训练动作头，将策略上下文与噪声直接映射为动作块，只需一次网络评估即可输出，显著降低推理延迟。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 基于扩散与流匹配的生成式动作模型能捕捉多模态行为（同一观测与指令下存在多条有效动作序列），但迭代采样需要重复网络评估，导致闭环控制中推理延迟高。作者希望在不牺牲多模态分布建模能力的前提下消除迭代采样。

Method: 提出 ESP，一种无需教师的单步方法，直接将策略上下文和噪声映射到动作块。其关键是用能量分数而非均方误差训练动作头：平方误差回归以条件均值为目标，而能量分数是严格真分数（strictly proper），其期望值唯一地被目标分布最小化，从而在模型能表示目标分布时给出总体最优下的精确恢复。

Result: 在仿真与真实世界操作任务上均取得有竞争力的任务成功率，同时动作生成延迟显著低于流匹配基线。

Conclusion: 直接分布学习可作为迭代式生成机器人策略的高效替代方案。

Abstract: Generative action models based on diffusion and flow matching have been increasingly adopted in vision-language-action (VLA) policies for their ability to capture diverse behaviors, including multiple valid action sequences under the same observation and instruction. Their iterative sampling procedures, however, require repeated network evaluations to generate each action chunk, increasing inference latency in closed-loop control. We propose ESP (Energy-Score Policy), a teacher-free approach that maps policy context and noise directly to an action chunk in a single network evaluation. ESP trains the action head with the energy score rather than mean squared error. Whereas squared-error regression targets the conditional mean, the energy score is strictly proper: its expected value is uniquely minimized by the target distribution. This provides a principled objective for learning multimodal action distributions without iterative sampling, with exact recovery at the population optimum when the model can represent the target distribution. Experiments on both simulation and real-world manipulation tasks demonstrate competitive task success with substantially lower action-generation latency than the flow matching baseline. These results support direct distributional learning as an efficient alternative to iterative generative robot policies.

</details>


### [529] [Seeing Through the Displaced Frame: Privileged Noise Distillation for Vision-Force Precision Assembly](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07745)
*Ching-Hsiang Chang,Tzu-Yu Chuang,Yi-Hsiu Lee,Yi-Ting Chen,Yuan-Fu Yang,Min Sun*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 该论文研究精密装配中由位姿误差引起的"坐标系偏移"问题，指出仅靠可部署感知无法解决，需在训练中提供编码偏移补偿的监督信号。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 精密装配中位姿误差不仅污染观测，还使机器人动作所处的坐标系发生偏移。由于同一估计位姿同时进入观测并锚定动作坐标系，这种偏移在接触前无法仅凭本体感知状态识别。在FORGE基准上，官方基于状态策略在真实位姿下成功率97%–99%，但在σ=5 mm噪声下仅32%–60%。

Method: 训练阶段两种方式提供缺失信息：(1) 特权教师策略在仿真中直接观测偏移；(2) 将干净示范以闭式解重标注到偏移后的坐标系中。部署的学生策略经行为克隆加一轮DAgger训练，测试时仅接收含噪状态、原始力/力矩窗口和两个RGB相机。并设置匹配的行为克隆实验以隔离鲁棒性来源。

Result: 在未修改的FORGE任务上，教师路线学生在σ=0至5 mm下保持92%–99%成功率，六个非特权基线降至2%–80%。匹配行为克隆实验中，同等架构、数据预算和训练流程下，无偏移访问的示范在σ=5 mm仅31.5%，特权与重标注示范分别达88.7%和95.8%。在Franka上零样本部署，σ=5 mm时学生达83.3%，最强基于状态策略仅34.4%。

Conclusion: 仅靠可部署感知不足以获得鲁棒性；鲁棒性需要能够编码潜在坐标系偏移补偿的监督信号。

Abstract: Pose error in precision assembly can corrupt not only what a robot observes but also the coordinate frame in which it acts. On the FORGE benchmark, the official state-based policy succeeds in 97% to 99% of episodes with the true pose but only 32% to 60% at the benchmark's $σ=5$ mm pose-noise setting. The same estimated pose enters the observation and anchors the action frame, making the offset unidentifiable from proprioceptive state alone before contact. We supply this missing information during training in two ways. A privileged teacher observes the offset in simulation, while clean demonstrations can instead be relabelled into the displaced frame in closed form. The deployed student is trained with behaviour cloning followed by one DAgger round and receives only noisy state, a raw wrench window, and two RGB cameras at test time. On the unmodified FORGE tasks, the teacher-route student maintains 92% to 99% success across $σ=0$ to 5 mm, while six non-privileged baselines fall to 2% to 80%. A matched behaviour-cloning experiment isolates the source of this robustness. With the same student architecture, data budget, and training procedure, demonstrations generated without offset access yield only 31.5% success at $σ=5$ mm, whereas privileged and relabelled demonstrations reach 88.7% and 95.8%. Deployed zero-shot on a Franka, the student reaches 83.3% pooled success at $σ=5$ mm against 34.4% for the strongest state-based policy. Deployable sensing alone is insufficient. Robustness requires supervision that encodes compensation for the latent frame offset.Project page: https://drychang.github.io/displaced-frame/

</details>


### [530] [CoRE: Learning Collaboration-Role Experts for Decentralized Collaborative Manipulation with One Policy](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07752)
*Yanan Zhou,Zhaoyan Qian,Zihao Li,Mingyuan Ba,Ranpeng Qiu,Weiming Zhi*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 提出 CoRE，通过从多任务多机器人示范中学习协作角色专家，实现单一策略、去中心化协作操作，无需任务提示、身份标签或机器人间通信。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 协作操作要求机器人随交互进展执行互补动作。研究单策略去中心化协作：每个机器人仅依赖视觉观测和本体感觉运行同一策略，不提供任务提示、身份标签或机器人间消息。核心挑战在于：在共享参数下学习互补团队行为，并从各自的局部观测中选择恰当动作。

Method: CoRE 从汇集的跨任务、多机器人示范中学习协作角色专家。融合外观与几何信息以提供局部交互证据；查询条件化的交叉注意力专家提供可适配的预测路径，由本地路由器在每个动作块位置上进行组合。训练时采用动作-专家对齐损失，在固定输入下基于相对强制路由预测误差来监督专家选择，无需角色标签。

Result: 在多个仿真基准上，CoRE 在评测的去中心化方法中取得最高平均性能；物理实验表明其能有效完成多样操作任务的协作，并对伙伴延迟与降速具有鲁棒性。

Conclusion: CoRE 表明，无需角色标签与通信、仅凭局部观测即可在共享参数中习得互补协作行为，为去中心化协作操作提供了可行方案。

Abstract: Collaborative manipulation requires robots to perform complementary actions as interactions unfold. We study single-policy decentralized collaboration: every robot runs the same policy from its visual observations and proprioception, without task prompts, identity labels, or inter-robot messages. The challenge is to learn complementary team behaviors within shared parameters and select appropriate actions from each robot's local observations. We introduce CoRE, which learns Collaboration-Role Experts from pooled multi-task, multi-robot demonstrations. Fused appearance and geometry provide local interaction evidence. Query-conditioned cross-attention experts provide adaptable prediction paths, which a local router combines at each action-chunk position. During training, an action-expert alignment loss supervises expert selection using relative forced-route prediction errors against demonstrations under fixed inputs, without role labels. Across simulation benchmarks, CoRE achieves the highest average performance among evaluated decentralized methods. Physical experiments demonstrate effective collaboration across diverse manipulation tasks and robustness to partner delays and slowdowns. Project page: https://aus.bot/research/core/.

</details>


### [531] [StairVLA: Stage-Aware Hierarchical Action Generation for Vision-Language-Action Models](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07756)
*Shangyuan Yuan,Xinda Qi,Yujiang Pu,Wenliang Guo,Xiaobo Tan*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: StairVLA 提出阶段感知的分层动作生成框架，用部分去噪动作作为高层粗生成与局部精修的接口，在保持性能的同时大幅降低推理延迟。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 现有 VLA 模型的扩散/流匹配动作头对去噪轨迹采用近乎统一的处理方式，但作者观察到去噪不同阶段的关注重点自然不同：早期结合语言指令与视觉观测建立粗动作轨迹，后期更侧重当前视觉观测进行动作对齐。这一特性未被现有方法利用，且高层 VLA 计算昂贵、难以频繁闭环。

Method: 提出 StairVLA，阶段感知的分层动作生成框架。高层 VLA 执行早期去噪，生成可复用的长时序部分去噪动作轨迹；轻量级 refiner 以更高频率运行，利用最新观测精修局部动作块。以部分去噪动作作为两层之间的自然接口，摊销高层 VLA 的昂贵计算，同时保留频繁的闭环修正。

Result: 在 LIBERO 上，GR00T 风格实例将平均成功率从 96.5% 提升至 97.8%，同时把每个动作块的摊销推理延迟从 115.0 ms 降至 44.2 ms。在两种 VLA 骨干、仿真基准和真实机器人任务上，StairVLA 均一致地降低推理成本并保持强任务性能。

Conclusion: StairVLA 通过阶段感知的分层设计，利用去噪过程的阶段性关注差异，实现了推理效率与任务性能的双重收益，具备跨骨干、跨场景的泛化性。

Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models increasingly rely on diffusion- or flow-matching-based action heads to generate continuous robot actions. These action heads typically process the denoising trajectory in a largely uniform manner. However, we observe that the conditioning focus naturally shifts across denoising stages: early stages combine language instructions and visual observations to establish a coarse action trajectory, whereas later stages place greater emphasis on current visual observations for action alignment. Based on this insight, we introduce StairVLA, a stage-aware hierarchical action generation framework that uses partially denoised actions as a natural interface between coarse long-horizon action generation and local refinement. A high-level VLA performs early denoising to produce a reusable long-horizon partially denoised action trajectory, while a lightweight refiner operates at a higher frequency to refine local action chunks using the latest observations. This design amortizes expensive high-level VLA computation while preserving frequent closed-loop correction. On LIBERO, our GR00T-style instantiation improves average success from 96.5% to 97.8% while reducing amortized inference latency from 115.0 ms to 44.2 ms per action chunk. More broadly, across two VLA backbones, simulation benchmarks, and real-robot tasks, StairVLA consistently reduces inference cost while maintaining strong task performance.

</details>


### [532] [Model-Based Geometry-Aware Generative Optimization for Constrained Locomotion Planning](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07772)
*Zhilin He,Xinyuan Wang,Changliu Liu*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出Model-Based Geometry-Aware Generative Optimization (2GO)，用于四足与类人机器人的受约束运动规划，通过将主动约束几何转化为可执行的去噪算子并引入自适应扩散/流式调度，提升了成功率、降低约束违反并改善执行兼容性。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 受约束运动规划需同时满足碰撞避免、接触一致性、运动学可行性与支撑约束，在高维动力学和高度非凸环境中极具挑战。现有基于模型的扩散(MBD)方法虽将轨迹优化转化为后验采样并无需示范学习，但受限变体仍存在两大局限：(1)缺少任务调制的主动约束几何来塑造得分方向与逆向随机性；(2)使用确定性的DDPM式逆向传输，缺乏跨生成传输的自适应调度。

Method: 提出2GO方法，把主动约束几何转化为可执行的去噪算子，具体通过正态诱导的度量塑造(normal-induced metric shaping)、切空间随机滤波(tangent-space stochastic filtering)以及基于CFS的回缩(CFS-based retraction)实现；同时通过自适应扩散与类流(flow-like)调度，将生成传输与逆向随机性解耦。

Result: 在受约束的四足与类人运动任务上验证，在离散落脚点选择与连续姿态规划中均表现优异，具有更高成功率、更少约束违反以及更好的执行兼容性。

Conclusion: 2GO通过几何感知的去噪算子与自适应调度，有效克服了现有基于模型扩散方法在约束几何塑造和逆向传输调度上的不足，为四足与类人机器人的受约束运动规划提供了性能更优的生成式优化方案。

Abstract: Constrained Locomotion Planning (CLP) for quadrupeds and humanoids, where robots must satisfy collision avoidance, contact consistency, kinematic feasibility, and support constraints, is challenging under high-dimensional dynamics and highly non-convex environments. Recent Model-Based Diffusion (MBD) approaches recast trajectory optimization as posterior sampling over trajectories, using known dynamics and Monte Carlo rollouts to analytically estimate the denoising score function without demonstration learning. While constrained variants further incorporate feasibility into model-based score rollouts and show promising performance, they are still limited by (1) lacking a task-modulated active constraint geometry that shapes the score direction and reverse stochasticity, and (2) using deterministic DDPM-style reverse transport without adaptive scheduling across different generative transports. Therefore, we introduce Model-Based Geometry-Aware Generative Optimization (2GO) for constrained locomotion, which turns active constraint geometry into executable denoising operators through normal- induced metric shaping, tangent-space stochastic filtering, and CFS-based retraction. 2GO further decouples generative transport from reverse stochasticity through an adaptive diffusion and flow-like schedule. Experiments on constrained quadruped and humanoid locomotion demonstrate strong performance in discrete foothold selection and continuous posture planning, with higher success rates, fewer violations, and improved execution compatibility.

</details>


### [533] [Multi-Robot Multi-Goal Motion Planning with Stochastic Skills](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07784)
*William Schnyder,Valentin N. Hartmann,Stelian Coros*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出将随机性操作技能整合进基于采样的多机器人规划中，通过在多模态复合路线图上构建马尔可夫决策过程（MDP），实现在规划阶段直接处理技能不确定性，从而获得可反应式协调策略。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 机器人常以群体形式在共享空间中执行实际任务，需要规划围绕复杂操作技能的并发运动。这些技能涉及连续物理执行且可能具有随机性，导致执行时间可变、连续轨迹不确定。现有规划器要么局限于单机器人、要么依赖开环路径、要么采用事后调度，无法实现动态协调。

Method: 在多模态复合路线图上将问题建模为马尔可夫决策过程（MDP），把随机技能纳入基于采样的多机器人规划框架。求解该MDP可得到反应式策略，使可控机器人能根据其他机器人执行操作技能的情况动态调整自身运动。

Result: 在规划阶段直接消解技能不确定性，避免了保守基线方法的悲观性，实现了鲁棒且动态的多机器人协调。规划器代码已公开。

Conclusion: 将随机技能与采样规划相结合并以MDP求解，为多机器人并发操作任务的动态协调提供了有效方案，优于开环或事后调度等既有方法。

Abstract: As robots are increasingly deployed in groups and share workspaces to execute real-world tasks, planning their concurrent motions around complex manipulation skills becomes essential. These skills involve continuous physical execution and may exhibit stochastic behavior, resulting in variable execution times and uncertain continuous trajectories. Existing planners either limit execution to single-robot scenarios, rely on open-loop paths, or use post-hoc scheduling that prevents dynamic coordination. In this paper, we address this gap by integrating stochastic skills into sampling-based multi-robot planning by formulating the problem as a Markov Decision Process (MDP) over a multi-modal composite roadmap. For stochastic skills, solving the MDP yields a reactive policy that allows controllable robots to dynamically adapt their motions in response to other robots' execution of manipulation skills. By resolving skill uncertainty directly at planning time, this approach avoids the pessimism of conservative baselines and unlocks robust, dynamic multi-robot coordination. Code for the planners is available at https://www.vhartmann.com/stochastic-skills.

</details>


### [534] [CUSP: CUSUM-Governed Survival Hazard Alarms at the Perception Onset for Off-Road Navigation](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.07882)
*Inuk Kang,Seung-Woo Seo*

Main category: cs.RO

TL;DR: 本文提出CUSP，一种模型无关的运行时危险报警方法，从被干预终止的越野导航日志中学习“感知起始点”（安全转向不安全的时刻），用视觉危险头配合离散时间生存目标和CUSUM累积风险生成报警，在五个未见场景中显著优于现有基线。


<details>
  <summary>Details</summary>
Motivation: 越野导航中机器人面临潜在危险地形。基于学习的导航虽用安全监督选择路径，但无法在机器人沿该路径驶向危险时提供运行时报警。此类报警需从实地日志学习，然而人类干预会抢先于失败发生，导致失败本身从未被观测，且干预标记的是较晚的判断点，而非更早的“不安全”判断时刻，这一更早时刻正是运行时报警需要检测的，但此前无方法针对它。

Method: 提出CUSP（CUSUM治理的感知起始生存模型），一种模型无关的运行时危险报警。将“感知起始点”（安全驱驶转为不安全的时刻）与干预分开标注；在标注的起始点上训练视觉危险头，采用离散时间生存目标，使有起始和无起始的驾驶都监督该头；再用CUSUM将预测的起始风险累积为报警。

Result: 在五个未见场景（两个自主、三个遥操作）评估，共142个事件，所有方法调至相同的每小时十次误报率。CUSP检测到85个事件，而九个适配基线中最佳仅检测到26个，且优势来自导航模型所有信号均无法察觉的危险。

Conclusion: CUSP能有效学习并检测干预前更早的感知起始时刻，实现模型无关的运行时危险报警，在相同误报率下检测性能远超现有基线，尤其对人类判断的不安全起始点这一现有方法忽略的目标有显著改进。
